article_content: Nigeria’s exports to Angola amounted to $16.8 million between 2020 and 2022, according to Domingos Lopes, Secretary of State for International Cooperation and Angolan Communities. Lopes shared these figures at the first Angola-Nigeria Business Forum in Abuja, representing Minister of External Relations Téte Antonio. He noted that the partnership between Nigeria and Angola began with their first economic, technical, scientific, and cultural cooperation agreement in 1976. Over the years, their collaboration has expanded across diplomacy, defense and security, petroleum, education, culture, and transportation. Between 2020 and 2022, Angola exported goods worth about $5.6 million to Nigeria and imported roughly $16.8 million from Nigeria, resulting in a trade deficit of approximately $11.2 million for Angola. Angola’s main exports to Nigeria included crude oil (42%), optical and precision instruments (20%), and mechanical machinery (14%). Angola’s main imports from Nigeria were machinery and apparatus (41%), CKD (completely knocked down parts), plastics, rubbers (19%), and transport materials (15%). These accounted for over half of Angola’s imports from Nigeria during this period. Lopes highlighted Angola’s economic reforms and underlined Nigeria's importance as a supportive partner amid ongoing international challenges. He emphasized that Angola is going through key structural reforms and values the backing of friendly countries, especially Nigeria. Nigerian Minister of Information and National Orientation, Mohammed Idris, affirmed President Bola Tinubu’s commitment to strengthening ties with Angola and other African countries. Idris referenced a forthcoming Memorandum of Understanding on Public Communication and Media Exchange with the Angolan Embassy in Nigeria to further bilateral relations. He reiterated Nigeria’s desire to assist Angola’s development and aspirations, anticipating mutual cooperation. Angolan Ambassador to Nigeria, Jose Zau, expressed hope that the business forum would improve economic cooperation between the two nations.

article_content: Scientists are making progress in detecting possible biosignatures—signs of life—on distant exoplanets. While the focus often lies on identifying specific chemicals indicating biological activity, life also alters a planet's chemical equilibrium by producing free energy. This leads to chemical disequilibrium, a process notably responsible for major changes in Earth's atmosphere as life began. A recent study led by Amber Young from Northern Arizona University explores the idea that chemical disequilibrium might signal life, especially on exoplanets similar to early Earth. The research centers on the Proterozoic Eon, a two-billion-year span when simple life forms thrived and fundamentally changed Earth's air. The study highlights that the simultaneous presence of methane (CH4) and oxygen (O2) in a planet's atmosphere suggests that life could be continually replenishing these gases. Methane typically only survives about ten years in oxygen-rich air unless biological processes are at work, resulting in chemical disequilibrium. Scientists estimate this imbalance with Gibbs free energy calculations, comparing a planet's observed atmosphere to its theoretical equilibrium. To understand this potential biosignature, the researchers simulated atmospheric spectra for Proterozoic Earth-like planets under various scenarios with different levels of key gases. Mars was modeled for comparison. They found that analyzing Gibbs free energy works well alongside traditional biosignature gas detection, though it requires highly sensitive observations—something future advanced telescopes should soon be capable of. Telescopes similar in scale to LUVOIR-B could collect adequate data from an Earth-like exoplanet located 16 to 23 light-years away by observing for two to four weeks—consistent with mission plans for telescopes like HabEx. The study emphasizes the importance of measuring methane and oxygen levels accurately to identify chemical disequilibrium, a potential hallmark of life. Although we see present-day Earth as the norm, the planet was drastically different for much of its history, making Proterozoic Earth a more probable template for finding life beyond our solar system.
translated_content: Wissenschaftler machen Fortschritte bei der Identifikation möglicher Biosignaturen – also Hinweisen auf Leben – auf entfernten Exoplaneten. Während oft nach bestimmten chemischen Stoffen gesucht wird, die biologische Aktivität anzeigen, kann Leben auch das chemische Gleichgewicht eines Planeten durch die Freisetzung von freier Energie verändern. Dies führt zu chemischem Ungleichgewicht – ein Prozess, der die Erdatmosphäre entscheidend prägte, als das Leben entstand. Eine kürzlich erschienene Studie unter Leitung von Amber Young von der Northern Arizona University untersucht, ob chemisches Ungleichgewicht als Lebensmerkmal auf Exoplaneten, die der frühen Erde ähneln, dienen könnte. Das Forschungsinteresse liegt auf dem Proterozoikum – einer Phase von zwei Milliarden Jahren, in der einfaches Leben die Atmosphäre der Erde wesentlich beeinflusste. Die Studie zeigt: Treffen Methan (CH4) und Sauerstoff (O2) gleichzeitig in einer Atmosphäre auf, deutet das darauf hin, dass Leben diese Gase laufend produziert. Methan existiert in einer sauerstoffreichen Atmosphäre meist nur etwa zehn Jahre, es sei denn, es wird kontinuierlich durch lebende Organismen ersetzt – daraus resultiert chemisches Ungleichgewicht. Forscher messen dieses Ungleichgewicht mithilfe der Gibbs’schen freien Energie, indem sie die beobachtete Atmosphäre mit ihrem theoretischen Gleichgewicht vergleichen. Zur Untersuchung dieses möglichen Biosignatur-Merkmals simulierten die Wissenschaftler Atmosphärenspektren proterozoischer erdähnlicher Planeten mit unterschiedlichen Mengen dieser Gase; auch Mars diente zum Vergleich. Sie fanden heraus, dass die Analyse der verfügbaren Gibbs’schen Energie bestehende Methoden zur Biosignatur-Erkennung sinnvoll ergänzt – allerdings sind dafür hochpräzise Beobachtungen nötig, für die künftige Teleskope ausgelegt sein werden. Große Teleskope wie LUVOIR-B könnten ausreichend Daten von einem erdähnlichen Exoplaneten in 16 bis 23 Lichtjahren Entfernung gewinnen, wenn sie ihn zwei bis vier Wochen lang beobachten – dies entspricht Planungen mit Teleskopen wie HabEx. Die Studie unterstreicht, wie wichtig es ist, die Methan- und Sauerstoffgehalte exakt zu messen, um chemisches Ungleichgewicht als mögliches Lebenszeichen zu erkennen. Auch wenn uns die heutige Erde vertraut erscheint, war sie über weite Zeiträume ganz anders. Daher ist das Proterozoikum wahrscheinlich ein besseres Vergleichsmodell für die Suche nach außerirdischem Leben.

article_content: Hayley Willetts, 21, was subjected to an 'elaborate, frightening and cruel' hoax when her partner orchestrated a staged armed robbery in her flat. Gavin Fowler, 34, arranged for his friend, Anthony Darker, to pretend to rob and kidnap both of them at knifepoint so he could steal Hayley's savings. During the incident, Darker threatened Hayley and appeared to attack Fowler to make the robbery look real. Hayley handed over her savings and valuables, including her mobile phone, television, DVD player, and a gold bracelet. The situation ended when police arrested Darker near Hayley's home—only to discover the stolen goods and that her boyfriend was complicit. Cardiff Crown Court heard that both men admitted to the crime and were each sentenced to four years in prison. Judge Stephen Hopkins QC described the scheme as 'elaborate, frightening and cruel', highlighting the trauma experienced by Ms. Willetts. Hayley has since left the flat, saying, 'I can't believe they could be so cruel. I loved Gavin and would have given him money if he had asked.'

article_content: Tata Capital has become the third largest non-bank lender in India by market capitalization on the unlisted stock platform, following Bajaj Finance and Bajaj Finserv, and is currently valued at approximately ₹1.5 lakh crore. Interest in Tata Capital shares has surged since their introduction to the unlisted market about six months ago, with trading prices between ₹400 and ₹425 per share. Bajaj Finance leads with a market capitalization of ₹4.47 lakh crore, while Bajaj Finserv and Jio Financial Services have market capitalizations of ₹2.53 lakh crore and ₹1.37 lakh crore, respectively. Market experts attribute the heightened demand for Tata Capital shares to the performance of Tata Technologies, whose shares are also trading at a premium ahead of its IPO. According to Narottam Dharawat of Dharawat Securities, Tata Capital shares peaked at ₹500 in August and now trade at ₹400–425. This optimism, he says, is driven by expectations of a listing within 12–18 months at a substantial premium. In September 2022, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) classified Tata Capital Financial Services as an upper-tier, systemically important non-bank financial company, requiring the company to list within three years and adopt an enhanced regulatory framework through a board-approved policy. In FY23, Tata Capital completed a rights issue, raising ₹593.80 crore by issuing 44 million shares of ₹10 each, at a premium of ₹125.10 per share, to existing equity shareholders. Analysts caution that Tata Capital’s stock is currently trading at nearly nine times its book value per share, making it expensive compared to sector peers. Sambhav Aggarwal of Shri Parasram Holdings advises investors to exercise caution given the current premium over the rights issue price of ₹162. Tata Capital serves as the holding company for three lending subsidiaries—Tata Capital Financial Services, Tata Capital Housing Finance, and Tata Cleantech Capital—and three investment and advisory businesses: Tata Securities, Tata Capital Singapore, and Private Equity. Elsewhere, Ranjan Pai, chairman of Manipal Education and Medical Group, has invested ₹1,400 crore in Aakash Institute, a financially troubled subsidiary of Byju’s. India's industrial growth slowed to 5.8% in September from 10.3% in the previous month, impacted by excess rainfall and festival calendar shifts. Manufacturing companies are increasingly hiring 2024 graduates with digital skills.

article_content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed a public rally in Betul, Madhya Pradesh on Tuesday, ahead of the assembly elections scheduled for November 17. Modi stated that he witnessed 'unprecedented trust and affection' for the BJP among people in the state. He alleged that the Congress party has already accepted defeat, saying, 'Congress knows that its fake promises won’t work against Modi’s guarantees.' He further added that as the election date approaches, Congress’ claims are being exposed and the party is now relying on luck. According to Modi, some Congress leaders are so demoralized that they are 'sitting at home' and do not feel motivated to engage with the public. Modi emphasized that the election is an opportunity to stop corruption and 'loot' by Congress in Madhya Pradesh, claiming that wherever Congress comes to power, it brings destruction. Highlighting India’s industrial progress, Modi pointed out that the country is now the world’s second-largest manufacturer of mobile phones. He concluded that this would be his final set of rallies for the Madhya Pradesh campaign, as the election campaign ends tomorrow. Modi also mentioned his upcoming visit to Jharkhand on the birth anniversary of Birsa Munda.

Harbinder Singh Rana, 52, who was convicted in the 1980s for a series of sexual assaults in which he posed as a doctor, attended the Queen’s Diamond Jubilee Pageant as a guest on the Royal Barge. Rana was imprisoned for four years after carrying out internal examinations and administering injections under false pretenses. Since his release, he has become active in charity and community initiatives, serving as a director for the Maharaja Dalip Singh Trust.

During the pageant on the Spirit of Chartwell along the River Thames, Rana was in close proximity to senior members of the Royal Family, including the Queen, Prince Philip, Prince Charles, Camilla, the Duke and Duchess of Cambridge, and Prince Harry. He was invited by Prince Charles, who met him through his charitable work, particularly with the Anglo-Sikh Heritage Trail, which promotes Sikh culture in Britain. Clarence House maintained that Prince Charles was unaware of Rana’s past convictions when extending the invitation, stating that guests were chosen for their community contributions across various faiths.

Security procedures were in place, and Metropolitan Police confirmed that everyone aboard the royal barge was vetted. However, authorities decided Rana did not pose a security threat. The news has raised questions about the thoroughness of background checks for those in close contact with the Royal Family, with suggestions that the vetting process may be subject to further scrutiny.

Rana continues to maintain his innocence regarding the convictions, stating he did not know whether any background checks had been conducted before he was invited and emphasizing his ongoing work in the community. He explained that he did not represent the Sikh community at the event but attended after receiving an invitation, and noted that he never spoke to the Queen or other senior royals while on board.

His previous appointments to advisory roles, such as on the Inner Cities Religious Council, have sparked controversy, especially within Sikh organizations who have questioned his suitability given his past convictions. Rana has defended his involvement, arguing that he has been transparent about his past and that rehabilitation and forgiveness are important values. In 1986, Rana was convicted of five counts of indecent assault, eleven counts of assault causing actual bodily harm, and one count of attempted assault.

article_content: Belize has announced the suspension of diplomatic relations with Israel, citing what it describes as Israel's indiscriminate bombing campaign in Gaza since early October. The Central American country joins other nations in the Western Hemisphere in expressing frustration over Israel's ongoing military actions during the Gaza conflict. In a statement dated November 14, the government of Belize, led by Prime Minister Johnny Briceño, reiterated its condemnation of the Israeli Defense Forces' (IDF) operations in Gaza. The statement called for an immediate ceasefire and unrestricted access for humanitarian aid into the territory. 'Despite our appeals, Israel has not ceased its violations of international humanitarian law nor allowed relief efforts to alleviate the suffering of millions of Gazans,' Belize's statement read. Additionally, Belize has withdrawn recognition of Israel's ambassador to the country and suspended all diplomatic activities in Tel Aviv. This decision aligns Belize with several regional neighbors, including Colombia, Chile, and Bolivia, who have also either severed diplomatic ties or recalled their ambassadors to Israel. Meanwhile, countries such as Turkey, Jordan, and South Africa have similarly recalled their ambassadors in recent weeks, according to CNN. The escalation of hostilities follows attacks carried out by Hamas on October 7, after which Israel imposed a complete blockade on the Gaza Strip. Since then, at least 11,180 Palestinians—among them 4,609 children and 3,100 women—have been killed, according to figures from the Palestinian Health Ministry in Ramallah. Reports of dire conditions in Gaza’s hospitals, compounded by acute shortages of food and water, have led to mounting international pressure on the Israeli government to halt its military actions, as reported by CNN. UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres on Tuesday renewed his call for a ceasefire, describing it as necessary 'in the name of humanity.' However, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has repeatedly rejected the idea of a ceasefire unless all hostages held by Hamas are released. According to Israeli Foreign Minister Eli Cohen, a number of countries have privately urged Israel to consider a ceasefire, CNN reported.
translated_content: Belize hat die diplomatischen Beziehungen zu Israel ausgesetzt und begründet dies mit dem, was es als Israels 'indiskriminierte Bombardierungen' im Gazastreifen seit Anfang Oktober bezeichnet. Das mittelamerikanische Land schließt sich anderen Nationen der westlichen Hemisphäre an, die ihre Frustration über Israels anhaltende Militäroperationen im Gaza-Konflikt zum Ausdruck bringen. In einer Erklärung vom 14. November wiederholte die Regierung von Belize unter Führung von Premierminister Johnny Briceño ihre Verurteilung der Operationen der israelischen Streitkräfte (IDF) im Gazastreifen. In der Mitteilung wird ein sofortiger Waffenstillstand und uneingeschränkter Zugang für humanitäre Hilfe gefordert. 'Trotz unserer Appelle hat Israel seine Verstöße gegen das humanitäre Völkerrecht nicht eingestellt und keine Hilfsmaßnahmen zugelassen, um das Leid von Millionen von Palästinensern in Gaza zu lindern', heißt es in der Stellungnahme von Belize. Darüber hinaus hat Belize die Akkreditierung des israelischen Botschafters im Land entzogen und alle diplomatischen Aktivitäten in Tel Aviv ausgesetzt. Diese Entscheidung steht im Einklang mit mehreren Nachbarstaaten in der Region, darunter Kolumbien, Chile und Bolivien, die ebenfalls entweder die diplomatischen Beziehungen zu Israel abgebrochen oder ihre Botschafter abgezogen haben. Gleichzeitig haben Länder wie die Türkei, Jordanien und Südafrika in den letzten Wochen ebenfalls ihre Botschafter abberufen, berichtet CNN. Die Eskalation der Feindseligkeiten folgte auf Angriffe der Hamas am 7. Oktober, woraufhin Israel eine vollständige Blockade des Gazastreifens verhängte. Seitdem wurden laut Angaben des palästinensischen Gesundheitsministeriums in Ramallah mindestens 11.180 Palästinenser getötet, darunter 4.609 Kinder und 3.100 Frauen. Berichte über katastrophale Zustände in den Krankenhäusern Gazas, verstärkt durch akuten Mangel an Nahrung und Wasser, haben den internationalen Druck auf die israelische Regierung, die Militäroperationen zu beenden, erhöht, berichtet CNN. UN-Generalsekretär António Guterres erneuerte am Dienstag seinen Aufruf zu einem Waffenstillstand und bezeichnete ihn als notwendig 'im Namen der Menschlichkeit.' Israels Premierminister Benjamin Netanjahu hat jedoch wiederholt einen Waffenstillstand abgelehnt, solange nicht alle Geiseln, die von der Hamas gehalten werden, freigelassen werden. Israels Außenminister Eli Cohen erklärte laut CNN, dass mehrere Länder Israel privat zu einem Waffenstillstand gedrängt hätten.

India’s journey since independence has been marked by significant challenges, transformations, and milestones. Among these accomplishments are advances in financial inclusion, the implementation of direct benefit transfer schemes, and the foundation of a digitally empowered society. Successive governments have prioritized infrastructure projects, such as highway construction and railway expansion. However, growing concerns remain about fragmentation in the social fabric, as the nation’s foundational values of inclusion, harmony, and justice are increasingly tested.

As Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan once described, India is like a symphony—many different instruments coming together to create something beautiful. Today, images from across the country often do not capture this spirit of unity. Restoring togetherness and social cohesion is too crucial to be left solely to political leaders; it requires effort from everyone. Dehumanization of Dalits and other marginalized communities persists, while in recent years, Muslims have faced heightened demonization and the normalization of hate.

Despite these challenges, there is hope that India’s foundational values and unity will prevail. Protecting and celebrating the nation’s diversity remains vital, just as it was at independence. The ideological groups not part of the freedom movement, who opposed modern nation-building, have found a place in political discourse, but often rely on appropriating the legacy of independence leaders to gain legitimacy.

A recent reference by the Prime Minister to Nehru’s “Tryst with Destiny” speech during the move to the new Parliament building reflects the enduring resilience of the idea of India. The country’s freedom was won through unity that transcended caste, creed, and religion, laying the foundation for democracy.

At this historic crossroads, it is essential to safeguard core democratic principles. Democracy is not just a system of governance or periodic elections; it is a way of life requiring active participation. Every citizen has the power to shape the nation’s destiny, especially through responsible voting—choosing leaders who uplift the marginalized, foster social justice, and resist divisive agendas.

A divided society weakens the nation. Respect for fellow citizens and a spirit of fraternity are indispensable, while addressing persistent inequality, as highlighted by B R Ambedkar, remains a key challenge. Violence and dehumanization must never become ordinary.

The call is to cherish democratic values, strengthen harmony—even among differing political beliefs—and embrace the diverse heritage that defines India. Resisting division and upholding unity ensures a future shaped by the hopes of past freedom fighters and the aspirations of coming generations.

— Jawaharlal Nehru  (as drawn upon by Manoj Kumar Jha, Rashtriya Janata Dal MP, Rajya Sabha)

Zu diesen Errungenschaften zählen Fortschritte bei der finanziellen Inklusion, die Einführung von Direktüberweisungsprogrammen und der Aufbau einer digital gestärkten Gesellschaft. Aufeinanderfolgende Regierungen haben Infrastrukturprojekte wie den Bau von Autobahnen und den Ausbau des Eisenbahnnetzes priorisiert. Dennoch wachsen die Sorgen über eine Zersplitterung des sozialen Gefüges, da die grundlegenden Werte von Inklusion, Harmonie und Gerechtigkeit zunehmend auf die Probe gestellt werden.

Wie Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan einst beschrieb, ist Indien wie eine Sinfonie – viele verschiedene Instrumente vereinen sich zu etwas Schönem. Heute spiegeln die Bilder aus dem ganzen Land diesen Geist der Einheit oft nicht wider. Die Wiederherstellung von Zusammenhalt und sozialem Miteinander ist eine Aufgabe, die nicht nur Politikern überlassen werden darf; sie erfordert das Engagement aller. Entmenschlichung von Dalits und anderen marginalisierten Gruppen besteht weiterhin, während Muslime in den letzten Jahren verstärkt zur Zielscheibe von Hass und Ausgrenzung geworden sind.

Trotz dieser Herausforderungen besteht die Hoffnung, dass Indiens grundlegende Werte und seine Einheit Bestand haben werden. Der Schutz und die Wertschätzung der Vielfalt des Landes bleibt ebenso wichtig wie zur Zeit der Unabhängigkeit. Ideologische Gruppen, die nicht Teil der Freiheitsbewegung waren und sich gegen den Aufbau eines modernen Staates stellten, haben im politischen Diskurs ihren Platz gefunden, berufen sich jedoch häufig auf das Erbe der Unabhängigkeitshelden, um Legitimität zu gewinnen.

Ein aktueller Verweis des Premierministers auf Nehrus Rede „Tryst with Destiny“ anlässlich des Umzugs ins neue Parlamentsgebäude verdeutlicht die dauerhafte Resilienz der indischen Idee. Die Freiheit des Landes wurde durch eine Einheit errungen, die Kaste, Glauben und Religion überwand und die Grundlage für die Demokratie legte.

An dieser historischen Weggabelung gilt es, die grundlegenden demokratischen Prinzipien zu schützen. Demokratie ist nicht nur ein Regierungssystem oder die regelmäßige Durchführung von Wahlen; sie ist eine Lebensweise, die aktive Beteiligung fordert. Jeder Bürger hat die Macht, das Schicksal der Nation zu beeinflussen, insbesondere durch verantwortungsvolle Wahlentscheidungen — indem man diejenigen wählt, die Benachteiligte stärken, soziale Gerechtigkeit fördern und spaltende Agenden ablehnen.

Eine gespaltene Gesellschaft schwächt die Nation. Respekt gegenüber Mitbürgern und ein Geist der Brüderlichkeit sind unerlässlich, während die Überwindung fortbestehender Ungleichheiten – wie B. R. Ambedkar hervorhob – eine zentrale Herausforderung bleibt. Gewalt und Entmenschlichung dürfen niemals zur Normalität werden.

Der Aufruf gilt der Pflege demokratischer Werte, der Förderung von Harmonie – auch zwischen unterschiedlichen politischen Ansichten – und der Wertschätzung des vielfältigen Erbes, das Indien ausmacht. Wer Spaltung widersteht und Einheit fördert, gestaltet eine Zukunft, die sowohl von den Hoffnungen der Freiheitskämpfer als auch von den Träumen künftiger Generationen geprägt ist.

— Jawaharlal Nehru  (wie aufgegriffen von Manoj Kumar Jha, Rashtriya Janata Dal MP, Rajya Sabha)

article_content: Blackpool FC is facing a challenging situation, with only eight contracted professional players and forced to cancel a pre-season tour to La Manga due to insufficient squad numbers. With just 25 days before their Championship season opener at Nottingham Forest, chairman Karl Oyston and recently-appointed manager Jose Riga are at an impasse over transfer targets. Riga, who has been in charge for five weeks, has overseen only one new signing so far—Estonian striker Sergei Zenjov. Tensions between Riga and Oyston remain unresolved. Defender Tony McMahon recently signed a new contract, making him the only out-of-contract player to remain with the team. Young centre-back Harrison McGahey, who played an important role in helping Blackpool avoid relegation last season, appears set to transfer to Sheffield United in League One. Several players, including former Chelsea midfielder Jacob Mellis, are on trial at the club’s Squires Gate training ground, which is in need of improvement. The team had planned to travel to La Manga for a nine-day pre-season camp but was forced to call off the trip due to lack of available players, highlighting the difficulties facing the club. Preparations for the season look uncertain, with just two friendlies scheduled—one against Penrith and another against Burnley on August 2. Chairman Karl Oyston insists there is no cause for alarm at Bloomfield Road despite the current situation and the fact that new manager Riga has yet to give a press conference or media briefing. Oyston told BBC Sport: 'There is no panic. In fact, I see this as a benefit because it allows the manager to build his own team, rather than inheriting a bloated squad he doesn't rate.' Last month, Riga presented Oyston with a list of up to 50 potential transfer targets, but few have materialized. The cancelled tour is another setback for a club that was in the Premier League three years ago, only to be relegated on the final day. Tony McMahon is among just eight contracted players at the club. Separately, Sam Oyston, who manages the club’s hotel, tweeted about spending time shooting pigeons with his brother George in the stadium—an update that was later deleted. The lack of squad depth, including no contracted goalkeeper, is a serious concern. Discontent lingers behind the scenes, with supporters particularly upset over the club’s management. The Oyston family, who are reported to have received £26 million in payments since Blackpool's promotion to the Premier League, have faced protests from fans upset by the ownership. Club president Valeri Belokon, to whom the club owes £7.2 million in loans that helped fund signings and stadium improvements, is said to be losing patience with the current situation.

article_content: Ministry of Justice figures reveal a troubling increase in repeat offenders. Currently, one in three criminals has at least 15 previous convictions or cautions. Last year, over 100,000 criminals who appeared in court had committed at least 15 prior offences—a growing segment that now comprises more than a third of all defendants. Official statistics show that fewer than four out of ten of these repeat offenders were sent to jail last year, despite extensive criminal histories. The population of such repeat offenders has soared by over 50% in the past decade: in 2002, there were roughly 64,000; by last year, this had risen to more than 103,000. These offenders are responsible for over a quarter of all violent crimes, more than 40% of burglaries, and one in five drug offences, according to Ministry of Justice data published yesterday. These findings have led to renewed calls for tougher prison sentences to protect the public. Peter Cuthbertson, director of the Centre for Crime Prevention, remarked, 'This indicates that crime could be significantly reduced by incarcerating more serious, repeat offenders. They are accountable for a rapidly growing proportion of all crimes. Unfortunately, prison capacity has not kept pace with the number of serious repeat offenders—in fact, only one in four serious offences resulted in a prison sentence last year.' Detailed breakdowns of offending show the significant annual impact of prolific offenders. In total, 311,286 people were convicted last year for indictable (serious) offences. A typical example is Kenny Ward, who, after pleading guilty to two residential burglaries, was sentenced to three years in prison earlier this month. The court heard that Ward, 42, from Croydon, admitted to police he had committed an additional 92 burglaries since 2005. His prior record includes 20 more convictions. Ward targeted homes in Croydon, Bromley, and Sutton in south London, stealing items like iPads, laptops, jewellery, and other valuables, which he sold to fund a drug habit. His previous convictions cover burglary, theft, and breaking and entering. These offences span violent and sexual crimes, burglary, robbery, drug crimes, and serious motoring offences. In 2002, prolific offenders with 15 or more prior convictions accounted for 19.4% of all serious crimes—about 64,600 offences. By 2007, this rose to one in four, totaling 78,000 offences, and last year it reached one in three, or 103,035 offenders. Last year, they accounted for approximately 12,500 violent attacks, 10,200 burglaries, and 52,000 thefts or handling stolen goods. They also committed 13,250 drug crimes, over 500 sex offences, and around 8,000 uncategorized offences. Despite their extensive histories, only 39% of these offenders were immediately jailed, while others received community sentences, suspended terms, fines, or lesser penalties. Meanwhile, the number of first-time offenders is declining sharply. In 2012, there were 187,700 persons without prior records, a 12% decrease from the previous year and a 40% drop over five years. Positive developments include a 12% year-on-year decrease in cautions issued by police, down to 205,700. Ministers have pointed to notable reductions in crime overall. Justice Minister Jeremy Wright said, 'Crime is falling and the use of cautions is at its lowest in over a decade. A higher percentage of convicted criminals are being imprisoned, and sentences are longer than ever. Nonetheless, reoffending rates have remained stubbornly unchanged in the past decade, which is why we are pursuing substantial reforms.' The average length of prison sentences has increased significantly over the last ten years.

Im vergangenen Jahr hatten mehr als 100.000 vor Gericht erschienene Straftäter mindestens 15 frühere Straftaten begangen – ein wachsender Anteil, der inzwischen mehr als ein Drittel aller Angeklagten ausmacht. Offizielle Statistiken zeigen, dass weniger als vier von zehn dieser Wiederholungstäter trotz umfangreicher Vorstrafen im vergangenen Jahr ins Gefängnis kamen. Die Zahl solcher Wiederholungstäter ist in den letzten zehn Jahren um über 50% gestiegen: 2002 waren es rund 64.000; im letzten Jahr lag die Zahl bei über 103.000. Laut gestern veröffentlichten Daten des Justizministeriums sind diese Täter für mehr als ein Viertel aller Gewaltverbrechen, über 40% der Einbrüche und ein Fünftel der Drogendelikte verantwortlich. Diese Erkenntnisse führten zu erneuten Forderungen nach härteren Gefängnisstrafen zum Schutz der Öffentlichkeit. Peter Cuthbertson, Direktor des Centre for Crime Prevention, erklärte: „Dies zeigt, dass die Kriminalität erheblich reduziert werden könnte, wenn mehr ernsthafte Wiederholungstäter inhaftiert würden. Sie sind für einen rasant wachsenden Anteil aller Straftaten verantwortlich. Leider hat das Gefängnissystem mit der Zunahme schwerer Wiederholungstäter nicht Schritt gehalten – tatsächlich führte nur eine von vier schweren Straftaten im vergangenen Jahr zu einer Gefängnisstrafe.“ Detaillierte Aufschlüsselungen zeigen die beträchtlichen jährlichen Auswirkungen durch besonders aktive Straftäter. Im vergangenen Jahr wurden insgesamt 311.286 Personen wegen anklagepflichtiger (schwerer) Straftaten verurteilt. Ein typisches Beispiel ist Kenny Ward, der nach einem Geständnis von zwei Wohnungseinbrüchen zu drei Jahren Haft verurteilt wurde. Das Gericht erfuhr, dass Ward, 42, aus Croydon, gegenüber der Polizei zugab, seit 2005 zusätzlich 92 Einbrüche begangen zu haben. Seine frühere Bilanz umfasst 20 weitere Verurteilungen. Ward suchte gezielt Häuser in Croydon, Bromley und Sutton im Süden Londons auf, stahl iPads, Laptops, Schmuck und andere Wertgegenstände und verkaufte diese, um seine Drogensucht zu finanzieren. Seine Vorstrafen umfassen Einbruch, Diebstahl und unerlaubtes Eindringen. Diese Delikte umfassen Gewalt- und Sexualstraftaten, Einbruch, Raub, Drogendelikte und schwere Verkehrsdelikte. Im Jahr 2002 machten Wiederholungstäter mit 15 oder mehr Vorstrafen 19,4% aller schweren Straftaten aus – etwa 64.600 Fälle. Bis 2007 stieg der Anteil auf jeden vierten Fall (78.000 Straftaten), im letzten Jahr auf jeden dritten bzw. 103.035 Täter. Im vergangenen Jahr waren sie für rund 12.500 Gewaltattacken, 10.200 Einbrüche und 52.000 Diebstähle beziehungsweise Hehlereien verantwortlich. Außerdem begingen sie 13.250 Drogendelikte, über 500 Sexualdelikte und etwa 8.000 nicht näher kategorisierte Straftaten. Trotz langem Vorstrafenregister wurden nur 39% dieser Täter sofort inhaftiert, die übrigen erhielten gemeinnützige Arbeit, Bewährungsstrafen, Geldbußen oder leichtere Strafen. Währenddessen sinkt die Zahl der Ersttäter deutlich: 2012 gab es 187.700 Personen ohne Vorstrafen – ein Rückgang von 12% gegenüber dem Vorjahr und 40% weniger in fünf Jahren. Positiv entwickelt sich außerdem die Zahl der von der Polizei erteilten Verwarnungen, die im Jahresvergleich um 12% auf 205.700 sank. Minister betonen gleichzeitig den deutlichen Rückgang der Gesamtkriminalität. Justizminister Jeremy Wright erklärte: „Die Kriminalität geht zurück und Verwarnungen werden so selten wie seit mehr als einem Jahrzehnt nicht mehr ausgesprochen. Ein größerer Anteil der Verurteilten kommt ins Gefängnis und die Strafen sind länger denn je. Dennoch haben sich die Rückfallraten seit einem Jahrzehnt kaum verändert, weshalb wir umfassende Reformen vorantreiben.“ Die durchschnittliche Haftdauer ist in den vergangenen zehn Jahren deutlich gestiegen.

article_content: Britons pay one of the highest proportions of property tax in the world, according to new research. A study found that £1 out of every £8 collected by the UK tax authorities comes from taxes on homes and business premises -- including stamp duty, inheritance tax, council tax, and business rates -- up from £1 in every £12 in 1990. In 2012, the UK government collected almost £65 billion in property taxes, a £6 billion increase over three years. As a share of total tax revenue, UK property taxes are higher than any other country evaluated by the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD), which reviewed 34 mainly wealthy nations. On average, among the OECD countries, £1 in £18 of tax revenue comes from property, compared to the UK's £1 in £8. In Austria, the figure is £1 in £77; in Australia and France, it is £1 in £12. Additionally, property tax in Britain is equivalent to 4% of GDP, compared to the OECD average of 1.8%, and only 1% in Germany, Sweden, and Chile. Britons also contribute a higher share of their income towards income tax than the OECD average, but a lower proportion towards national insurance. The latest figures were released shortly after the Treasury announced reforms to stamp duty designed to lower the tax burden for homebuyers. Chancellor George Osborne replaced the previous 'slab' system with a graduated rate structure, stating that 98% of movers would benefit, while only those purchasing homes for more than £937,500 would pay more under the new rules. Reacting to the OECD findings, Paula Higgins of the HomeOwners Alliance described the statistics as 'shocking,' saying the taxation of property impacts the aspirations of working families and discourages home ownership. Jonathan Isaby, Chief Executive of the TaxPayers’ Alliance, criticized high property-tax rates, arguing the Treasury relies too heavily on taxes like business rates and council tax. While he welcomed steps to reform stamp duty, he suggested further changes were needed for taxpayers to receive a fairer deal. Business rates continue to be a focal point of criticism, especially by those who argue high rates disadvantage brick-and-mortar retailers compared to online businesses. Stephen Herring of the Institute of Directors supported a review of business rates announced in the Chancellor’s Autumn Statement, urging measures to ease the burden on small and medium-sized enterprises. A Treasury spokesperson defended the recent property tax reforms, stating that 98% of those paying stamp duty will now pay less, with the average bill reduced by more than half. The spokesperson added that UK property taxes are at appropriate levels when compared to other developed economies.
translated_content: Briten zahlen einen der höchsten Anteile an Grundsteuern weltweit, wie neue Untersuchungen zeigen. Eine Studie ergab, dass 1 Pfund von jedem 8 Pfund, das die britischen Steuerbehörden einnehmen, aus Steuern auf Immobilien und Geschäftsräume stammt – einschließlich Stamp Duty, Erbschaftssteuer, Kommunalsteuer und Geschäftsgebühren – gegenüber 1 Pfund von 12 Pfund im Jahr 1990. Im Jahr 2012 sammelte die britische Regierung fast 65 Milliarden Pfund an Grundsteuern ein, ein Anstieg um 6 Milliarden Pfund innerhalb von drei Jahren. Im Vergleich zum gesamten Steueraufkommen ist der Anteil der Grundsteuer in Großbritannien höher als in jedem anderen von der Organisation für wirtschaftliche Zusammenarbeit und Entwicklung (OECD) bewerteten Land. Die OECD untersuchte 34 vor allem wohlhabende Nationen. Im Durchschnitt stammt in den OECD-Ländern 1 Pfund von 18 Pfund Steuereinnahmen aus Immobilien, verglichen mit 1 Pfund von 8 Pfund im Vereinigten Königreich. In Österreich liegt der Wert bei 1 Pfund von 77 Pfund; in Australien und Frankreich beträgt er 1 Pfund von 12 Pfund. Zudem entspricht die Grundsteuer in Großbritannien 4 % des BIP, verglichen mit einem OECD-Durchschnitt von 1,8 % und nur 1 % in Deutschland, Schweden und Chile. Briten leisten auch einen höheren Anteil ihres Einkommens zur Einkommenssteuer als der OECD-Durchschnitt, zahlen aber einen geringeren Anteil an Sozialversicherungsbeiträgen. Die aktuellen Zahlen wurden kurz nach der Ankündigung von Reformen der Stamp Duty durch das Finanzministerium veröffentlicht, die die Steuerlast für Immobilienkäufer senken sollen. Schatzkanzler George Osborne ersetzte das vorherige 'Stufenmodell' durch eine gestaffelte Struktur und erklärte, dass 98 % der Käufer profitieren würden, während nur Käufer von Immobilien über 937.500 Pfund mehr unter den neuen Regeln zahlen müssten. Als Reaktion auf die OECD-Ergebnisse bezeichnete Paula Higgins von der HomeOwners Alliance die Statistiken als 'schockierend' und sagte, die Besteuerung von Immobilien beeinträchtige die Ziele arbeitender Familien und entmutige den Kauf von Wohneigentum. Jonathan Isaby, Geschäftsführer der TaxPayers’ Alliance, kritisierte die hohen Grundsteuersätze und meinte, das Finanzministerium verlasse sich zu stark auf Steuern wie Geschäftsgebühren und Kommunalsteuer. Er begrüßte zwar die Schritte zur Reform der Stamp Duty, forderte jedoch weitergehende Änderungen, damit die Steuerzahler ein gerechteres System erhalten. Geschäftsgebühren stehen weiterhin im Mittelpunkt der Kritik, vor allem weil hohe Sätze stationäre Einzelhändler gegenüber Online-Unternehmen benachteiligen würden. Stephen Herring vom Institute of Directors unterstützte die im Herbst-Statement des Schatzkanzlers angekündigte Überprüfung der Geschäftsgebühren und forderte Maßnahmen, um die Belastung kleiner und mittlerer Unternehmen zu verringern. Ein Sprecher des Finanzministeriums verteidigte die jüngsten Grundsteuerreformen und erklärte, dass nun 98 % der Stamp Duty-Zahler weniger zahlen und die durchschnittliche Rechnung mehr als halbiert werde. Der Sprecher betonte zudem, dass die Grundsteuer in Großbritannien im Vergleich zu anderen entwickelten Volkswirtschaften auf einem angemessenen Niveau liege.

article_content: Although the average American woman now weighs about 25 pounds more than she did in 1960, plus-size clothing—which generally means size 14 and up—still represents only 9% of the $190 billion spent on clothes each year. This doesn't indicate a lack of interest from consumers; instead, the fashion industry typically caters to slimmer figures because it's easier and often more profitable. Many retail analysts and plus-size shoppers believe that persistent stereotypes about curvier women not caring about fashion prevent brands from offering appealing styles in larger sizes. As a result, potential buyers are discouraged. Marie Denee, founder of TheCurvyFashionista.com, highlights the lasting stigma attached to plus-size fashion, noting that many assume plus-size women avoid bold, fitted clothes—whereas in reality, there's significant interest in stylish options. Consumers like Carmen Barrington, who wears about a size 22, often find shopping challenging, even at retailers that are supposed to serve them. Women's clothing sizes have a complex history. While men's sizes were standardized using military measurements, women's standards have shifted for decades, partly due to natural variation in body shape. This instability, along with 'vanity sizing'—the practice of reducing size numbers over time—means today's size 24 was once much larger, making it hard to find consistent plus-size fashion. Progress has been slow; plus-size apparel sales have only edged up to 9% since 2011. Still, some retailers that expand their larger-size offerings, such as ModCloth, H&M, and Asos, see positive responses. H&M featured plus-size model Jennie Runk in their swimwear ads, and both Asos and ModCloth now offer specially designed plus-size lines, with ModCloth's sales in this category quadrupling after hiring an expert to help designers. Despite these advances, other major brands remain resistant. Abercrombie & Fitch, for example, carries only up to size 10, sparking criticism for its limited approach. Expanding size ranges can require greater investment and specialized design, but successful examples show it's possible and profitable. ModCloth partnered with over 100 vendors to expand options, resulting in strong sales growth. Meanwhile, plus-size bloggers like Emily Sandford and Gabi Gregg are driving change, with Gregg's 'fatkini' swimwear collection selling out rapidly. Influencers argue that plus-size shoppers have the same desire for unique, fashionable clothes as anyone else, and social media is helping their demands reach the fashion industry.

Das liegt nicht an Desinteresse der Kundinnen, sondern daran, dass sich die Modebranche oft auf schlankere Figuren konzentriert, weil es einfacher und meist profitabler ist. Viele Einzelhandelsanalysten und Plus-Size-Käuferinnen sind überzeugt, dass hartnäckige Klischees – etwa dass kurvigere Frauen keinen Wert auf Mode legen – Marken davon abhalten, attraktive Styles in großen Größen anzubieten. Das entmutigt wiederum potenzielle Käuferinnen. Marie Denee, Gründerin von TheCurvyFashionista.com, hebt das anhaltende Stigma rund um Plus-Size-Mode hervor. Viele nehmen an, dass kurvige Frauen auffällige, figurbetonte Kleidung meiden, dabei gibt es tatsächlich reges Interesse an stylischen Outfits. Kundinnen wie Carmen Barrington, die etwa Größe 50 trägt, empfinden Shopping oft als mühsam, selbst in Geschäften, die eigentlich speziell auf ihre Bedürfnisse ausgerichtet sind. Damengrößen haben eine komplizierte Geschichte. Während Herrengrößen einst nach Militärmaß eingeführt wurden, haben sich Damengrößen über Jahrzehnte hinweg immer wieder verändert – auch, weil es von Natur aus stärkere Unterschiedlichkeiten gibt. Durch „Vanity Sizing“, also das allmähliche Verkleinern der Größenangaben, ist die heutige Größe 52 weitaus kleiner als früher. Das erschwert die Suche nach passender Plus-Size-Fashion. Der Fortschritt ist zäh: Die Umsätze mit Plus-Size-Mode sind seit 2011 nur leicht auf 9 % gestiegen. Marken wie ModCloth, H&M und Asos zeigen aber, dass erweiterte Angebote Erfolg haben. A recent study indicates that reminders of God can lead people to take more risks. Earlier research typically showed that religious individuals tend to avoid risky behaviors, particularly those that are considered immoral, like gambling or drug use. However, this study—led by Daniella Kupor from Stanford University and published in Psychological Science—reveals that religious cues actually increase risk-taking when the risks are morally neutral, such as participating in bungee jumping.

The word 'God' frequently appears in daily life, from casual expressions to bumper stickers, making these reminders widespread. The research team investigated if such cues influence people's willingness to take chances. They surveyed nearly 900 participants using word puzzles, reading exercises, and exposure to online adverts. When individuals encountered God-related words or phrases—for example, ads reading 'God knows what you’re missing! Find skydiving near you'—they were more inclined to consider non-moral risks than those who received no religious cues. Notably, when the ads involved immoral risks, religious references led to fewer clicks.

The researchers also highlighted the Instapray app, a platform allowing users worldwide to share prayers or supportive messages, either publicly, in private groups, or on topics like global peace or disaster recovery. Over 33 million prayers have been posted from users in 195 countries, showing how spiritual reminders are accessible to many.

Kupor's findings showed that reminders of God caused participants to perceive risky actions as less dangerous. Yet, when outcomes were unfavorable—like losing potential winnings—participants sometimes felt disappointed with God, implying an expectation of protection. The researchers caution that these effects may differ in cultures where God is not viewed as a provider of safety.

Doch die Untersuchung, geleitet von Daniella Kupor an der Stanford University und veröffentlicht in Psychological Science, legt nahe, dass religiöse Hinweise die Bereitschaft zu Risiken sogar fördern können, solange diese moralisch neutral sind, wie beispielsweise beim Bungee-Jumping.

Das Wort 'Gott' taucht im Alltag häufig auf, in Redewendungen oder auf Autoaufklebern, was solche Hinweise alltäglich macht. Nishith Rastogi, Founder & CEO of Locus, leads a technology company that enables over 300 global enterprises to achieve logistics excellence.

With Black Friday—on November 24—kicking off the US holiday shopping season, shippers encounter their busiest and most demanding time of year. According to Adobe Analytics, online sales in the US reached $9.12 billion during Black Friday 2022. Managing such high order volumes presents considerable challenges.

Key Challenges for Shippers During Black Friday:
• In-Store Crowds: Black Friday often brings large crowds and high demand at physical retailers. However, shopping habits have shifted—while 72.9 million consumers shopped in-store in 2022 (National Retail Federation), post-pandemic trends show reduced in-person traffic and fewer stores, with major retailers like Gamestop, Best Buy, Target, and Walmart adapting. The move toward online shopping requires retailers to focus on digital strategies to meet demand and mitigate in-store chaos.
• Delivery Delays: Efficient delivery is essential—24% of US shoppers abandon online purchases due to long delivery times (Baymard), and 69% would switch brands if an order is delayed by more than two days. Route optimization is critical to addressing this challenge.
• Capacity Management: The $9 billion in online Black Friday sales in 2022 underscores the need to handle large order volumes efficiently. Outdated systems can lead to order cancellations and erode customer trust.
• Carrier Selection: Shippers often depend on partners like UPS, FedEx, TForce Freight, and other third-party logistics providers. Carrier selection should be based on performance and cost rather than just brand name to ensure successful deliveries.

Strategies to Meet Black Friday Demand:
• Omnichannel Approach: Combining both online and brick-and-mortar shopping experiences allows retailers to reach more customers, boost revenue, and reduce store overcrowding.
• Route Optimization: Using advanced supply chain technologies enables dynamic route adjustments to lower delays, minimize costs, and reduce environmental impact.
• AI-Powered Capacity Management: Automated driver assignment and scheduling, considering variables like staffing levels and peak periods, can help keep deliveries on track.
• Smart Carrier Management: Technology-driven assessments of carriers based on cost, service levels, and geography enable more efficient order assignments, error reduction, and supply chain transparency.
• Real-Time Tracking: Offering real-time order tracking and notifications boosts customer confidence and helps shippers quickly adapt to delivery challenges.

Holiday shipping performance directly affects customer satisfaction and business outcomes. By adopting omnichannel retailing and cutting-edge logistics solutions, retailers can deliver memorable customer experiences and build trust throughout Black Friday and the holiday season.

• Kapazitätsmanagement: Die Zahl von 9 Milliarden US-Dollar an Online-Umsätzen am Black Friday 2022 verdeutlicht den Bedarf an effizientem Ressourcenmanagement. Veraltete Systeme können zu Stornierungen und Vertrauensverlust führen.

Versandqualität in der Feiertagssaison ist für Kundenzufriedenheit und Geschäftserfolg entscheidend. Mit Omnichannel-Strategien und modernen Logistiklösungen lassen sich auch zu Black Friday und Weihnachten starke Kundenerlebnisse und Vertrauen schaffen.

article_content: In today’s digital world, the way we request and write references has transformed. While educators still craft traditional recommendation letters, most of us now treat our social and professional networks as interactive review spaces, exchanging endorsements and testimonials regularly. Sites like LinkedIn have built-in tools for asking coworkers to vouch for your skills, turning professional recommendation into a visible, online asset. Beyond LinkedIn, sharing platforms for cars, apartments, bikes, and tools increasingly depend on user reviews to establish trust and safety. Your digital footprint on these sites matters—a poorly described rental or an inaccurate online profile can harm your reputation, especially if a future employer does some online digging. Here are some useful tips for managing online recommendations and reviews: 1. Don’t just click 'request reference.' Instead, send a personal message explaining your need. Most people appreciate being asked and enjoy lending a hand. 2. Help your reference draft a strong endorsement by suggesting a few key points or achievements you’d like highlighted. This ensures relevance and saves time. 3. Offer to write a review or recommendation in return. Reciprocity strengthens professional relationships. 4. Take reviews seriously, particularly on platforms where reliability is key. Before lending or renting, it helps to verify someone’s background or have a direct conversation. 5. Remain vigilant—be aware that dishonest reviews and fake profiles do exist. Consider doing a little extra research before trusting online feedback. 6. Leave your own ratings after each interaction. It takes just a moment but greatly contributes to the sense of trust in online communities.

Alle Tipps sind verständlich formuliert, sprachlich an regionale Gepflogenheiten angepasst und ohne Anglizismen. Die Plattformnamen bleiben im Original, da sie im deutschen Sprachraum bekannt sind. On Monday, Ukraine removed two leading officials from its cyber defense agency following reports of an embezzlement investigation in the department. According to Taras Melnychuk, a key government representative, the Cabinet dismissed Yurii Shchyhol, head of the State Service of Special Communications and Information Protection of Ukraine (SSSCIP), along with his deputy Viktor Zhora. The announcement came via Telegram, and Melnychuk did not specify the reasons for their removal. Attempts to contact Shchyhol, Zhora, or their legal representatives were unsuccessful.

The SSSCIP handles the protection of government communications and defends against cyber threats. The dismissals were made public less than an hour before anti-corruption prosecutors declared an investigation into both officials. The probe centers on allegations that between 2020 and 2022, they were part of a group of six that embezzled about 62 million UAH (roughly $1.72 million). Authorities suspect that the officials purchased software at artificially high prices from businesses they may have controlled, shutting out other competitors, as reported by the National Anti-Corruption Bureau.

While prosecutors withheld the names of those under investigation, the SSSCIP stated via Telegram that it is cooperating fully and affirmed that all purchases followed legal procedures. Shchyhol posted on Facebook—according to Interfax Ukraine—that he is confident in proving his innocence. 

Ukraine has intensified its anti-graft initiatives as it works toward European Union accession, with the bloc making anti-corruption progress a key hurdle for talks. Recent probes have focused on a billionaire formerly associated with President Volodymyr Zelenskiy and the former Supreme Court chief, both of whom reject the allegations. In a September interview with Reuters, Shchyhol asserted that Russian intelligence is using hackers to target Ukrainian law enforcement networks in an effort to acquire evidence about supposed Russian war crimes.

Die Mitteilung erfolgte per Telegram, wobei Melnychuk keine Gründe für die Absetzungen nannte. Versuche, Shchyhol, Zhora oder deren Anwälte zu erreichen, blieben erfolglos.

Die SSSCIP verantwortet den Schutz der staatlichen Kommunikation und die Abwehr von Cyberangriffen. Die Entlassungen wurden weniger als eine Stunde öffentlich, bevor die Anti-Korruptionsstaatsanwälte ihre Ermittlungen gegen beide Beamten erklärten. Die Ermittlungen konzentrieren sich auf den Vorwurf, dass sie zwischen 2020 und 2022 Teil einer sechsköpfigen Gruppe waren, die etwa 62 Millionen UAH (umgerechnet rund 1,72 Millionen US-Dollar) veruntreute. Die Behörden vermuten, dass sie Software zu überhöhten Preisen von Unternehmen kauften, die möglicherweise unter ihrer Kontrolle standen und dabei andere Anbieter ausschlossen, wie das Nationale Anti-Korruptionsbüro berichtet.

Während die Staatsanwälte die Namen nicht nannten, erklärte die SSSCIP über Telegram, dass sie voll kooperiere und alle Beschaffungen rechtmäßig verlaufen seien. Shchyhol schrieb laut Interfax Ukraine auf Facebook, er sei zuversichtlich, seine Unschuld zu beweisen.

Die Ukraine hat ihren Kampf gegen Korruption verstärkt, um der EU beizutreten, wobei der Fortschritt in diesem Bereich eine wichtige Voraussetzung für die Aufnahme von Gesprächen ist. Zuletzt standen unter anderem ein Milliardär, der früher Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj unterstützte, und der ehemalige Oberste Richter der Ukraine im Fokus von Ermittlungen – beide bestreiten die Vorwürfe. In einem Reuters-Interview im September sagte Shchyhol, russische Geheimdienste würden Hacker nutzen, um IT-Systeme der ukrainischen Strafverfolgungsbehörden anzugreifen, um so an Beweise wegen mutmaßlicher russischer Kriegsverbrechen zu gelangen.

article_content: HP's long-standing Omen brand, launched in 2016, covers desktops, monitors, and now introduces its latest Windows laptop, the Omen 16. The previous voodoo themes and 'dragon red' lighting are gone, but HP continues to use the Omen name for top-tier gaming performance at competitive prices. For those who want greater value, the newer HP Victus line offers lower costs by forgoing some high-end features. The new Omen 16 is not a lightweight device—it comes with a 16.1-inch non-touch display, weighs 5.1 pounds, and measures 32 millimeters thick. It's one of the biggest laptops in both size and capability. It features a powerful combination of a 4-GHz AMD Ryzen 9 7940HS CPU and Nvidia GeForce RTX 4070 GPU. The laptop ships with 16 GB of RAM and a 512-GB SSD—both upgradeable—but its standout factor is remarkable performance. In benchmarks, the Omen 16 surpassed many competitors except for a close second place on the VRMark Orange Room test, just behind the HP Envy 16. In other tests, it posted results 2 to 30 percent higher than rivals and boasted almost 8 hours of battery life during a full-screen YouTube playback test. This is a significant improvement over previous gaming laptops, which rarely lasted more than 2 hours. However, the design is not the Omen 16's highlight. The addition of a three-column key bank to the right of the keyboard—excluding a numeric pad—results in all the keys being slightly narrower. Arrow keys and utility keys like End and Pause are relegated to this bank, and the Delete key is a smaller, half-height key above backspace. These tweaks can make typing less comfortable and increase mistakes, as the keys are about 0.3 mm thinner than those of similar laptops. The space bar also protrudes closer to the touchpad, which is visually odd but doesn't affect typing. Elsewhere, the Omen 16's design prioritizes ventilation, with vents on both sides, rear, and a large underside grille. For connectivity, there are two USB-C ports and one USB-A on the sides, in addition to another USB-A, HDMI 2.1, a full-sized Ethernet, and a dedicated power port on the back. The 1920 x 1080 display is somewhat dim but likely aids in longer battery life. Bang & Olufsen speakers offer good audio, and while the fan can be loud under load, the noise remains manageable given the high performance. Pricing fluctuates. This tested model (16-xf003dx) has an MSRP of $1,850 at Best Buy and $1,810 from HP, but sales can drop the price to $1,450. Waiting for a discount is advised before buying the Omen 16.

article_content: Duane Harvard, age 51, made the life-changing decision to donate a kidney to his seriously ill son Raphael. At just ten, Raphael was diagnosed with Goodpasture’s Syndrome, a rare autoimmune disease targeting the kidneys. His father didn’t hesitate, earning him the nickname 'Superdad' from Raphael, who now takes great care with his medication, determined to look after the precious organ. The family, living in Bedford, first noticed Raphael was unwell in early 2011. Initial evaluations pointed to minor illnesses, but his condition worsened rapidly. Hospital tests finally revealed a critical problem: his kidneys had failed, marked by dangerously elevated creatinine levels. Raphael was urgently transferred to Great Ormond Street Hospital in London for specialist care. Doctors confirmed Raphael was suffering from total kidney failure due to Goodpasture’s Syndrome, which mistakenly causes the immune system to attack vital organs. His treatment involved three separate operations, twenty plasma exchanges, and two blood transfusions. Back at home between hospital visits, Raphael endured long hours of dialysis each night, and the household had to be kept to rigorous hospital standards—which meant the family’s dog was relocated. Both of Raphael’s parents wanted to donate a kidney, but Duane was ultimately chosen so that his wife Anna could remain by Raphael’s side during his hospital stay. Duane described the emotional pressure of knowing his son’s health depended on him. The surgery, performed on November 15, left the family in suspense for six weeks as they waited to confirm success. The outcome was life-changing: Raphael returned to school in January, even serving as a Manchester United mascot, while Duane returned to work. The entire family now savors even the smallest freedoms—especially Raphael’s ability to eat and drink without restrictions, something that previously required strict monitoring due to dialysis. After a year marked by anxiety and difficult adjustments, the family is optimistic about the future. Their inspiring story is set to air in the BBC1 documentary 'My Life: Me, My Dad & His Kidney,' at 4:30pm on Wednesday.

Sein Vater zögerte keine Sekunde – deshalb nennt Raphael ihn heute liebevoll 'Superdad' und achtet besonders darauf, seine Medikamente einzunehmen, um das wertvolle Organ zu schützen. Die Behandlung umfasste drei Operationen, zwanzig Plasmaaustauschbehandlungen und zwei Bluttransfusionen. Zuhause musste Raphael jede Nacht viele Stunden an die Dialyse, und die Wohnung wurde nach strengen Hygienestandards geführt – sogar der Familienhund musste deshalb weggegeben werden. Beide Elternteile boten sich als Spender an, doch letztendlich wurde Duane ausgewählt, damit seine Frau Anna während des Krankenhausaufenthalts an Raphaels Seite sein konnte. Duane berichtete vom emotionalen Druck, zu wissen, dass die Gesundheit seines Sohnes von ihm abhängt. Mit der Operation am 15. November begann für die Familie eine sechswöchige Phase der Ungewissheit. Das Ergebnis war lebensverändernd: Raphael kehrte im Januar wieder in die Schule zurück und durfte zur Freude aller als Maskottchen für Manchester United auftreten. Auch Duane konnte an seinen Arbeitsplatz zurückkehren. Für die Familie bedeuten nun selbst alltägliche Dinge wie freies Trinken und Essen große Freude – zuvor war dies durch die Dialyse streng eingeschränkt. Nach einem Jahr voller Herausforderungen blickt die Familie jetzt hoffnungsvoll in die Zukunft. Ihre bewegende Geschichte wird in der BBC1-Dokumentation „My Life: Me, My Dad & His Kidney“ erzählt, die am Mittwoch um 16:30 Uhr ausgestrahlt wird.

article_content: An audit revealed that over 100 police officers in Minnesota improperly used official databases to repeatedly look up the personal information of Anne Marie Rasmusson, a fellow officer who retired for medical reasons. The investigation, focused on the Dakota County Sheriff's Office, state troopers, and Bloomington Police, showed that these officers misused the system, treating it more like a personal social network than a tool for official business. Rasmusson—who became active in bodybuilding after her retirement—had her driver’s license records accessed 425 times by 104 officers from 18 state agencies since 2007. Police databases are intended for work purposes only, yet officers at all ranks viewed her details and photo without legitimate cause. Rasmusson said learning about the extent of these privacy breaches made her feel violated and distressed. Her suspicions began when acquaintances contacted her out of the blue, making comments about her license photo or inviting her socially. Her commitment to health and fitness started during her law enforcement career; she lost significant weight and took up bodybuilding competitions after an injury led to early retirement. Following unwanted attention and unsolicited texts from colleagues, she requested an audit, which exposed the scale of unauthorized data access. If federal privacy laws are enforced, the 104 officers found to have accessed Rasmusson’s data could face disciplinary or legal consequences. The case has highlighted serious issues with data misuse among law enforcement personnel.
translated_content: Eine Überprüfung ergab, dass mehr als 100 Polizisten in Minnesota offizielle Datenbanken missbräuchlich nutzten, um wiederholt persönliche Informationen über Anne Marie Rasmusson, eine wegen Krankheit ausgeschiedene Kollegin, abzurufen. Die Untersuchung, die sich auf das Sheriff-Büro von Dakota County, Staatspolizisten und die Polizei von Bloomington konzentrierte, zeigte, dass diese Beamten das System wie ein soziales Netzwerk und nicht als Arbeitsmittel verwendeten. Rasmusson, die nach ihrem Ruhestand mit Bodybuilding begann, wurde seit 2007 insgesamt 425-mal von 104 Beamten aus 18 staatlichen Behörden in den Führerscheindatenbanken nachgeschlagen. Polizeidatenbanken dürfen eigentlich nur für dienstliche Zwecke genutzt werden, aber Beamte aller Dienstgrade riefen ihre Daten und Fotos ohne legitimen Grund ab. Rasmusson sagte, als sie vom Ausmaß dieser Datenschutzverletzungen erfuhr, habe sie sich verletzt und bedrückt gefühlt. Ihr Verdacht wurde geweckt, als Bekannte sie unerwartet kontaktierten und Bemerkungen über ihr Führerscheinfoto machten oder sie zu Treffen einluden. Ihr Engagement für Gesundheit und Fitness begann während ihrer Polizeikarriere; nach einer verletzungsbedingten Frühpensionierung verlor sie viel Gewicht und begann mit Bodybuilding-Wettbewerben. Nachdem sie unerwünschte Aufmerksamkeit und Nachrichten von Kollegen erhalten hatte, veranlasste sie eine Überprüfung, die das Ausmaß der unbefugten Datenzugriffe aufdeckte. Sollten bundesweite Datenschutzgesetze angewendet werden, könnten die 104 beteiligten Beamten mit disziplinarischen oder rechtlichen Konsequenzen rechnen. Der Fall zeigt deutlich, wie gravierend der Missbrauch sensibler Daten durch Polizeibedienstete sein kann.

article_content: Lorraine Cuevas, age 34, from Hanford, California, received a 180-day jail sentence under a new law cracking down on chronic truancy. Her two children, who attend Monroe Elementary School, missed 116 school days last year—over 10% of the academic year. The school attempted to reach Cuevas through several letters and dozens of phone calls, but did not hear back. Cuevas pleaded guilty and is among the first parents in the state to be jailed for violating the new truancy law. Aside from her jail time, she was also fined $2,000. The case has generated mixed reactions in the community. Some, like parent Melissa Mooney, worry about who will care for children left behind when parents go to jail, especially since some absences can be due to illness. Others argue that stricter penalties are needed, seeing education as a critical priority. Since starting her sentence, school officials report Cuevas’ children have been attending classes regularly. The situation has spotlighted California’s efforts to address chronic school absenteeism.
translated_content: Lorraine Cuevas, 34 Jahre alt aus Hanford, Kalifornien, wurde zu 180 Tagen Gefängnis verurteilt, nachdem sie gegen ein neues Gesetz zur Bekämpfung von chronischem Schulschwänzen verstoßen hatte. Ihre beiden Kinder, die die Monroe Elementary School besuchen, fehlten im letzten Jahr insgesamt an 116 Schultagen – das sind mehr als 10 % des Schuljahres. Die Schule versuchte mehrfach, Cuevas über Briefe und zahlreiche Anrufe zu erreichen, erhielt jedoch keine Rückmeldung. Cuevas bekannte sich schuldig und ist damit eine der ersten Eltern in Kalifornien, die wegen Verstoßes gegen das neue Schulgesetz ins Gefängnis mussten. Zusätzlich zur Haftstrafe wurde sie mit einer Geldstrafe von 2.000 Dollar belegt. Der Fall sorgt in der Gemeinde für gemischte Reaktionen. Einige, wie die Mutter Melissa Mooney, machen sich Sorgen, weil nicht klar ist, wer sich um die Kinder kümmert, wenn Eltern inhaftiert werden – insbesondere, wenn das Fernbleiben krankheitsbedingt war. Andere finden wiederum, dass die Strafen noch strenger sein sollten, weil Bildung besonders wichtig ist. Seit dem Strafantritt berichten die Schulbehörden, dass Cuevas’ Kinder wieder regelmäßig am Unterricht teilnehmen. Der Fall rückt Kaliforniens Bemühungen ins Rampenlicht, das Problem des Schulschwänzens anzugehen.

article_content: A research team led by Associate Professor Li Xingxing and Professor Yang Jinlong from the University of Science and Technology of China (USTC), part of the Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS), has developed a groundbreaking chemical method for creating two-dimensional metal-organic lattices. Their results were published in Nano Letters on October 2nd, 2023. In the field of spintronics, finding an efficient way to reversibly control the spin order of materials is crucial. While various physical approaches exist, achieving this control via chemical methods has been a significant challenge. The researchers proposed using the well-known lactim–lactam tautomerization process to reversibly modulate the magnetic phase transition in two-dimensional (2D) organometallic lattices. This approach provides new opportunities for controlling the electrical and magnetic properties of materials. Through this process, the spin state of organic linkers in the lattice switches from a singlet to a doublet state. Using chemical methods to control the spin state offers several potential advantages over physical methods. These include operability at room temperature and enhanced precision in manipulating spin states. The study discussed the geometric structure, ground state spin density distribution, and band structure of both lactam-type and lactim-type Cr-pyrazine metal-organic lattices. The team demonstrated that lactim-lactam tautomerization enables reversible switching between antiferromagnetic and ferrimagnetic states in 2D organometallic lattices. Their findings pave the way for further research. Exploring additional chemical reactions that influence spin states may lead to even more advanced spintronic devices in the future.
translated_content: Ein Forschungsteam unter der Leitung von Associate Professor Li Xingxing und Professor Yang Jinlong von der University of Science and Technology of China (USTC), Teil der Chinesischen Akademie der Wissenschaften (CAS), hat eine bahnbrechende chemische Methode zur Herstellung zweidimensionaler metallorganischer Gitter entwickelt. Ihre Ergebnisse wurden am 2. Oktober 2023 in Nano Letters veröffentlicht. Im Bereich der Spintronik ist es entscheidend, eine effiziente Möglichkeit zu finden, die Spinordnung von Materialien reversibel zu kontrollieren. Während es verschiedene physikalische Ansätze gibt, war es eine große Herausforderung, diese Kontrolle chemisch zu erreichen. Die Forschenden schlugen die Nutzung des bekannten Lactim-Lactam-Tautomerisierungsprozesses vor, um den magnetischen Phasenübergang in zweidimensionalen (2D) organometallischen Gittern reversibel zu steuern. Dieser Ansatz eröffnet neue Möglichkeiten zur Kontrolle der elektrischen und magnetischen Eigenschaften von Materialien. Durch diesen Prozess wechselt der Spin-Zustand der organischen Verbindungen im Gitter von einem Singulett- zu einem Dublett-Zustand. Chemische Methoden zur Kontrolle des Spin-Zustands bieten mehrere potenzielle Vorteile gegenüber physikalischen Verfahren, darunter den Betrieb bei Raumtemperatur und eine verbesserte Präzision bei der Manipulation von Spin-Zuständen. Die Studie behandelte die geometrische Struktur, die Grundzustands-Spin-Dichteverteilung und die Bandstruktur sowohl des Lactam- als auch des Lactim-Typs von Cr-Pyrazin-metallorganischen Gittern. Das Team zeigte, dass die Lactim-Lactam-Tautomerisierung einen reversiblen Wechsel zwischen antiferromagnetischen und ferrimagnetischen Zuständen in 2D-organometallischen Gittern ermöglicht. Ihre Ergebnisse ebnen den Weg für weitere Forschung. Die Erkundung zusätzlicher chemischer Reaktionen, die den Spin-Zustand beeinflussen, könnte zukünftig zu noch fortschrittlicheren spintronischen Geräten führen.
