article_content: Japan and North Korea are scheduled to resume discussions tomorrow regarding 17 Japanese citizens abducted by North Korea in the late 1970s. North Korea has admitted to capturing these individuals and transporting them to special espionage camps, intending to train them as spies before potentially sending them back to Japan as agents. Among the abductees are Keiko Arimoto, who was a student in London in 1983 when she was taken, and Tadaaki Hara, who was kidnapped after being lured out for drinks by an agent while working at a Chinese restaurant. Kaoru Matsuki and Toru Ishioka were abducted in Madrid in May 1980. Miyoshi Soga and her 19-year-old daughter Hitomi disappeared in 1978 after going grocery shopping. Yaeko Taguchi vanished in Tokyo in June 1978, leaving behind two young children. Shuichi Ichikawa and Rumiko Masumoto were kidnapped during a beach trip in August 1978. Japan's Foreign Minister Fumio Kishida expressed hope that the upcoming talks, which will take place in Beijing, will lead to progress. He emphasized the importance of North Korea's special investigation committee having the authority to thoroughly probe all relevant institutions and conduct a genuine investigation. Prime Minister Shinzo Abe mentioned he may consider visiting North Korea to advance the negotiations. Of the 17 abductees, five have returned to Japan. North Korea claims eight have died, though Japan suspects there may be additional, unacknowledged victims. A special North Korean committee has been established to investigate the abductions. Families of the missing recently met to discuss their position on the talks. Shigeo Lizuka, a spokesperson for the victims' families, told The Japan Times, ‘This time, I think, North Korea will not cheat us.’ The talks occur as North Korea conducts missile and rocket tests, overseen by leader Kim Jong-un. Other abductees include Kyoko Matsumoto, who was kidnapped on her way to knitting class in western Japan in 1977; Yutaka Kume, who was abducted by a supposed friend on the western coast; Minoru Tanaka, taken while visiting Vienna in 1978; and Megumi Yokota, who disappeared on her way home from badminton practice in November 1977.

Zu den Entführten gehören Keiko Arimoto, die 1983 als Studentin in London verschleppt wurde, und Tadaaki Hara, der von einem Agenten beim Arbeiten in einem chinesischen Restaurant zum Trinken eingeladen und dann entführt wurde. Kaoru Matsuki und Toru Ishioka wurden im Mai 1980 in Madrid entführt. Miyoshi Soga und ihre 19-jährige Tochter Hitomi verschwanden 1978 nach dem Lebensmitteleinkauf. Yaeko Taguchi verschwand im Juni 1978 in Tokio und ließ zwei kleine Kinder zurück. Shuichi Ichikawa und Rumiko Masumoto wurden bei einem Ausflug zum Strand im August 1978 entführt. Der japanische Außenminister Fumio Kishida äußerte die Hoffnung, dass die bevorstehenden Gespräche, die in Peking stattfinden werden, Fortschritte bringen. Premierminister Shinzō Abe erklärte, er erwäge sogar einen Besuch in Nordkorea, um die Verhandlungen voranzutreiben. Von den 17 Entführten sind fünf nach Japan zurückgekehrt. Nordkorea behauptet, acht seien gestorben, während Japan vermutet, dass es weitere nicht anerkannte Opfer gibt. Die Familien der Vermissten haben sich kürzlich getroffen, um ihre Position zu den Gesprächen zu besprechen. November 1977 auf dem Heimweg vom Badmintontraining verschwand.

article_content: Ruth Williams, a mother of two, learned about the unexpected death of her husband, David Williams, through a sudden call from a North Wales police officer while she was at work. David, 35, died of a severe asthma attack at a neighbor’s house. At first, Ruth, 32, who was working at the Golden Fleece pub in Tremadog, believed the call was a cruel prank. After lodging a complaint, North Wales Police issued a final written warning to the officer involved, describing his actions as wholly inappropriate. Initially, the police explained that the officer had answered a call to David’s phone and felt compelled to break the news. However, an investigation determined he had actually called Ruth’s mobile number to notify her, which is not normal protocol. Superintendent Peter Newton acknowledged, 'It is uncommon for North Wales Police to inform next of kin about a death by phone. In this case, it was entirely inappropriate, and the Force, along with the officer, have apologized to Mrs. Williams.' David and Ruth had been married six years and have two young daughters. Ruth expressed that being told face-to-face would have been less distressing. The case drew criticism from local councillor Alwyn Gruffydd, who agreed the police should have handled the notification differently. North Wales Police confirmed the responsible officer received a final written warning.

article_content:
Minnesota Congressman Dean Phillips filed to run for president on Friday after urging Joe Biden to step aside. Phillips' bid is widely seen as a long shot, but some view it as a sign of increasing dissatisfaction among Democrats with Biden's leadership.

The 54-year-old former businessman has for months advocated for a 'moderate' Democrat to enter the 2024 presidential race. Currently, only two other Democrats have stepped forward to challenge Biden.

Since 2019, Phillips has represented a mostly suburban Minneapolis district in the House of Representatives. On Friday, he officially filed to appear on the New Hampshire primary ballot, the nation's first presidential primary.

In an interview with CBS, Phillips said he believes Biden has done a 'spectacular job' as president but expressed concern over Biden's ability to defeat former president Donald Trump in a general election. 'This is an election about the future,' Phillips said. 'I will not sit still and be quiet in the face of numbers clearly indicating we could face an emergency next November.'

A Gallup poll released this week showed Biden’s job approval rating among Democrats dropped 11 points in the past month to 75%—the lowest of his presidency. Overall, Biden’s approval stands at 37%, with only 5% of Republicans approving of his performance.

In New Hampshire, some Democrats were upset after Biden reduced the state's influence in the 2024 primary calendar, prompting state party chairman Ray Buckley to caution in a letter that this could lead to 'embarrassment' from 'an insurgent candidate, serious or not.'

Despite these challenges, Biden maintains strong support from the Democratic establishment and donors. In a Friday fundraising email for Biden, Minnesota Governor Tim Walz appeared to gently criticize Phillips, remarking that people in the state sometimes 'make political side shows for themselves.' Walz added, 'One other thing is true of Minnesota: We love Joe Biden.'

Ameshia Cross, a Democratic strategist, told the BBC that Phillips’ campaign is a 'moon shot' due to his limited national recognition. She noted that many presidential runs are launched to gain media attention or raise one’s profile. While Cross acknowledged Biden’s low national poll numbers, she warned against reading too much into polls so far from Election Day. 'National polls this far before an election typically mean little,' she said. 'Much can change before November.'

To date, only Marianne Williamson, a self-help author, and left-wing talk show host Cenk Uyghur, are challenging Biden in the Democratic primaries. Robert F Kennedy Jr initially launched a Democratic campaign but has since decided to run as an independent, unaffiliated with either major party.

Seit 2019 vertritt Phillips einen überwiegend vorstädtischen Wahlkreis im Großraum Minneapolis im US-Repräsentantenhaus. Am Freitag hat er seine Anmeldung für die Vorwahl in New Hampshire, der ersten US-Präsidentschaftsvorwahl, offiziell eingereicht.

Eine diese Woche veröffentlichte Gallup-Umfrage ergab, dass Bidens Zustimmungsrate unter den Demokraten im letzten Monat um 11 Punkte auf 75 % gefallen ist – der niedrigste Wert seiner bisherigen Amtszeit. Einige Demokraten in New Hampshire zeigten sich verärgert, nachdem Biden den Einfluss des Bundesstaats im Präsidentschaftsvorwahlkalender 2024 reduziert hatte. Landesparteichef Ray Buckley warnte in einem Schreiben, dies könne zu einer „Blamage“ durch „einen aufrührerischen Kandidaten, ernst gemeint oder nicht“ führen.

Sie erklärte, viele präsidiale Kandidaturen würden gestartet, um Medienaufmerksamkeit zu bekommen oder das eigene Profil zu stärken. Aktuell stellen sich nur Marianne Williamson, eine Selbsthilfebuchautorin, und der linke Talkshow-Moderator Cenk Uyghur Biden in den demokratischen Vorwahlen entgegen. Robert F Kennedy Jr. hatte ursprünglich als Demokrat kandidieren wollen, ist nun aber als unabhängiger Kandidat angetreten.

article_content: In HBO Max’s pirate comedy 'Our Flag Means Death,' it’s clear that Edward Teach (Taika Waititi) and Stede Bonnet (Rhys Darby) are in love. However, in season two, showrunner David Jenkins gives Izzy Hands (Con O’Neill), the jilted first mate, a new chance to shake up the relationship dynamic and perhaps vie for the captains' attention. 'I think the three of them are on an inseparable arc together,' Jenkins told io9. 'Watching Izzy process what happened in season one and seeing him grow to find his own story and step away from a toxic relationship is interesting to me and gives him lots of room for growth.' In the first season, Izzy had a highly antagonistic relationship with Stede and was more or less forced to stay with Ed. This season, he tries not only to help Stede but also to take control of his own life apart from Ed. In two emotional moments during the early episodes, both Ed and Izzy confess they care for each other, although they are still figuring things out. When io9 noted that Con O’Neill’s performance was exceptional this season, Jenkins quickly corrected, 'He’s great every season.' He added, 'I love that character, and what Con brings to Izzy is so interesting.' Jenkins concluded, 'I love all my characters equally, but I have a special fondness for Izzy Hands.' For more pop culture news, io9 provides updates on upcoming releases for Marvel, Star Wars, Star Trek, the DC Universe, and Doctor Who.

Das bietet ihm viel Raum zur Entwicklung.“ In der ersten Staffel hatte Izzy eine sehr gegensätzliche Beziehung zu Stede und wurde mehr oder weniger gezwungen, bei Ed zu bleiben. In dieser Staffel versucht er nicht nur, Stede zu helfen, sondern auch, sein Leben selbst in die Hand zu nehmen – unabhängig von Ed. In zwei emotionalen Momenten in den ersten Episoden gestehen sich sowohl Ed als auch Izzy, dass sie einander wichtig sind – auch wenn sie noch herausfinden müssen, was das für sie bedeutet. Als io9 anmerkte, dass Con O’Neills Leistung in dieser Staffel außergewöhnlich sei, stellte Jenkins richtig: „Er ist in jeder Staffel großartig.“ Er ergänzte: „Ich liebe diese Figur, und was Con aus Izzy macht, ist superinteressant.“ Abschließend sagte Jenkins: „Ich liebe all meine Figuren gleichermaßen, aber für Izzy Hands habe ich eine besondere Zuneigung.“ Mehr Popkultur-News gibt’s bei io9 zu den neuesten Veröffentlichungen von Marvel, Star Wars, Star Trek, dem DC-Universum und Doctor Who.

article_content: Typhoon Parma swept through northern Philippines over the weekend, triggering deadly landslides that resulted in at least 12 fatalities, including two children aged 8 and 10, local reports said. Three other storm-related deaths were already confirmed earlier. Known locally as Typhoon Pepeng, Parma is expected to remain north of Luzon for several days, bringing heavy rains to an area still recovering from last week's Typhoon Ketsana, according to CNN meteorologist Ivan Cabrera. He noted that while rain will persist, winds are not projected to be as strong. As of late Saturday, the storm had maximum sustained winds of 120 kph (74 mph). Aid agencies are on-site, supporting survivors. Wilma Lacaden, representing World Vision, reported widespread devastation: uprooted trees, downed power lines blocking roads, light-constructed homes destroyed, power outages, and overflowing rivers isolating towns and villages. The organization distributed food and candles to 200 families Saturday and aimed to deliver additional relief to 350 families in Zambales on Sunday. Parma struck a rural, coastal region populated by fishers and farmers, forcing tens of thousands to evacuate. High winds toppled power lines in Cagayan Province and debris impeded evacuation routes. Manila managed to avoid a direct hit, and residents reported sunny weather on Sunday. However, the city and much of the country are still grappling with the aftermath of two major typhoons. Local resident Arturo Fidelino described the ongoing difficulties, highlighting strong community bonds and the enduring 'bayanihan spirit'—neighbors helping each other. Fidelino also shared that his 73-year-old mother had to be evacuated after flooding reached her home. Meteorologists predicted up to 20 inches of rain in areas still submerged from Ketsana, which brought the worst rainfall in 40 years and left 80 percent of Manila underwater. Ketsana caused 246 fatalities, left 38 people missing, and affected close to 2 million residents. Organizations like World Vision and local communities continue their relief efforts, distributing aid and working together to assist those hardest hit.
translated_content: Taifun Parma fegte am Wochenende über den Norden der Philippinen und verursachte tödliche Erdrutsche, bei denen mindestens 12 Menschen starben, darunter zwei Kinder im Alter von 8 und 10 Jahren, wie lokale Berichte meldeten. Drei weitere, mit den Unwettern verbundene Todesfälle waren bereits zuvor bestätigt worden. Der auch als Taifun Pepeng bekannte Parma wird voraussichtlich noch mehrere Tage nördlich von Luzon verweilen und heftige Regenfälle über eine Region bringen, die sich noch immer von Taifun Ketsana in der Vorwoche erholt, so CNN-Meteorologe Ivan Cabrera. Gleichzeitig wird weniger Wind als zuvor erwartet. Am späten Samstagabend erreichte der Sturm anhaltende Windgeschwindigkeiten von 120 km/h (74 mph). Hilfsorganisationen unterstützen die Überlebenden bereits vor Ort. Wilma Lacaden von World Vision berichtete über erhebliche Schäden: Herausgerissene Bäume, umgestürzte Stromleitungen blockieren Straßen, leichte Häuser wurden zerstört, zahlreiche Stromausfälle und über die Ufer getretene Flüsse machen Orte und Dörfer unerreichbar. Die Organisation versorgte am Samstag 200 Familien mit Lebensmitteln und Kerzen und plante, am Sonntag 350 weitere Familien in Zambales mit Hilfspaketen aus Lebensmitteln und Wasser zu unterstützen. Parma traf eine ländliche Küstenregion mit vielen Fischern und Bauern; Zehntausende mussten fliehen. In der Provinz Cagayan legten starke Winde Stromleitungen lahm und Trümmer behinderten Evakuierungen. Manila blieb von einem direkten Treffer verschont. Die Bewohner berichteten am Sonntag von sonnigem Wetter. Dennoch kämpfen die Hauptstadt und große Teile des Landes weiterhin mit den Folgen zweier heftiger Taifune. Bewohner Arturo Fidelino schilderte die anhaltenden Herausforderungen und hob den starken Zusammenhalt und den weiterhin lebendigen 'Bayanihan-Geist' hervor – also die gegenseitige Hilfe in der Nachbarschaft. Fidelino schilderte auch, dass seine 73-jährige Mutter nach Überflutung ihres Hauses evakuiert werden musste. Meteorologen sagen bis zu 50 Zentimeter zusätzlichen Regen für Gebiete voraus, die noch immer unter Wasser stehen, nachdem Ketsana zuvor für die schwersten Regenfälle seit 40 Jahren gesorgt und 80 Prozent von Manila überflutet hatte. Ketsana führte zu 246 Todesopfern, 38 Menschen gelten als vermisst und fast 2 Millionen waren betroffen. Organisationen wie World Vision und lokale Nachbarschaften setzen die Hilfe fort, verteilen Unterstützung und arbeiten zusammen, um die schlimm Getroffenen zu unterstützen.

article_content: Banks have come under criticism for refusing to refund victims of 'vishing' scams, according to Peter Burt, the former chief executive of Bank of Scotland. Burt asserts that money stolen through vishing—where fraudsters impersonate bank staff over the phone and persuade customers to transfer funds—should be automatically returned to customers. Victims, often elderly or otherwise vulnerable, are misled into believing their accounts are at risk from cybercriminals, only to lose their funds after making the authorized transfers. Despite the discovery of such fraud, many customers do not receive compensation because the banks maintain that transfers were authorized. Burt has called for victims to pursue legal action against banks that refuse to return their stolen money. He argues that while banks claim to have carried out reasonable checks, this standard is insufficient, describing the situation as 'a disgrace.' Following his tenure at Bank of Scotland, which ended after its 2003 merger with Halifax, Burt told The Sunday Times that banks contribute to fraud by opening accounts for criminals who provide false identification. Last year, the British Bankers' Association launched the 'Know Fraud, No Fraud' campaign to educate the public. The association emphasized that no legitimate bank would request a full PIN or password over the phone or email, nor ask customers to urgently authorize a transfer. A spokesperson added: 'Banks are determined to stop such crimes. It is important that each case is handled individually and that banks work closely with customers.'

Das sagte Peter Burt, der ehemalige Vorstandschef der Bank of Scotland. Er ist der Meinung, dass Geld, das durch Vishing – also durch Betrüger, die sich am Telefon als Bankangestellte ausgeben und Kunden zur Überweisung von Geldern bewegen – gestohlen wurde, den Kunden automatisch zurückerstattet werden sollte. Die Opfer, oft ältere oder anders gefährdete Menschen, werden dazu verleitet zu glauben, dass ihre Konten durch Cyberkriminelle bedroht sind, und verlieren nach der autorisierten Überweisung ihr Geld. Trotz der Aufdeckung solcher Betrugsfälle erhalten viele Kunden keine Entschädigung, weil die Banken darauf verweisen, dass die Überweisungen autorisiert wurden. Burt fordert, dass die Opfer rechtliche Schritte gegen Banken einleiten, die gestohlenes Geld nicht zurückgeben. Er argumentiert, dass es nicht ausreicht, wenn Banken nur behaupten, angemessene Prüfungen vorgenommen zu haben, und bezeichnet die Situation als „eine Schande“. Nach seiner Zeit bei der Bank of Scotland, die nach der Fusion mit Halifax im Jahr 2003 endete, sagte Burt der Sunday Times, dass Banken zur Begehung von Betrugsfällen beitragen, indem sie Konten für Kriminelle eröffnen, die gefälschte Identifikationen vorlegen. Im vergangenen Jahr startete die British Bankers' Association die Kampagne „Know Fraud, No Fraud“, um die Öffentlichkeit zu informieren. Die Vereinigung betonte, dass keine seriöse Bank am Telefon oder per E-Mail nach einer vollständigen PIN oder einem Passwort fragt oder Kunden zu einer sofortigen Überweisung auffordert. Ein Sprecher fügte hinzu: „Banken sind entschlossen, solche Straftaten zu bekämpfen. Es ist wichtig, dass jeder Fall individuell bearbeitet wird und die Banken eng mit den Kunden zusammenarbeiten.“

The London 2012 Olympic closing ceremony featured a star-studded fashion showcase that sparked surprise among some in the 70,000-strong audience—not only due to Boris Johnson's energetic dancing. Many were puzzled by the inclusion of Victoria Beckham's high-end designer label in a hall of fame featuring established names such as Vivienne Westwood and Alexander McQueen.

Beckham's relatively young brand, launched in 2007, appeared alongside Britain's most acclaimed designers, with model Georgia May Jagger wearing a gold fit-and-flare dress designed by Beckham. Jagger joined a lineup of models including Lily Cole, Karen Elson, Stella Tennant, Kate Moss, Lily Donaldson, Jourdan Dunn, Naomi Campbell, and David Gandy.

The event's fashion showcase was highly selective, featuring only nine designers: Alexander McQueen, Vivienne Westwood, Christopher Kane, Burberry, Erdem, Jonathan Saunders, Stephen Jones, Paul Smith, and Victoria Beckham. Some observers questioned whether Beckham's inclusion, considering her brand's recent launch and mixed critical reviews, was warranted or simply promotional.

Each designer was represented by a supermodel. Beckham created the bespoke gold gown in gazar specifically for the event, explaining in an interview that she drew inspiration from 'the ideas of high performance—in terms of quality, fit, fabric, and stitching,' and revisited one of her signature designs. Reportedly, eleven cutters and designers help produce Beckham's collections.

Beckham's designs have attracted praise and criticism, particularly over high pricing—mainline dresses often cost around £1,650, and leather leggings £1,250. The Victoria, Victoria Beckham line, promoted as more accessible, was also questioned when a sleeveless wool dress sold for £500 and a day dress for £750. Additionally, she has faced scrutiny for describing her range as ‘British’ despite manufacturing garments in Morocco and Portugal.

article_content: Arun Malhotra, an automotive industry expert, points out that India's luxury car segment remains small, with annual sales totaling about 45,000 vehicles. Electric cars comprise an even smaller share—at 30% adoption, that's only 12,000 cars each year. Malhotra questions whether Tesla’s entry can truly revolutionize the market or make high-end EVs accessible for the wider public, noting it’s uncertain if Tesla can offer vehicles in the Rs 8–12 lakh range to appeal to mainstream buyers. India’s shift toward premium cars is growing as more buyers are willing to invest in luxury. Even with Tesla potentially entering, the country has roughly ten EV manufacturers—most prioritizing the semi-premium and luxury markets, which keeps the sector limited in scope. Electric vehicles account for just 1.5% of overall car sales, though the figure climbs to 6–7% in the luxury segment. Presently, government incentives via the FAME scheme mostly target commercial vehicles; about 90% of passenger EVs aren’t eligible and instead benefit only from reduced GST. High price tags remain a major obstacle: Tesla’s current offerings cost Rs 55–60 lakh, and even if locally assembled, could remain above Rs 40 lakh unless a cheaper, India-specific model is introduced. Unlike two-wheelers, where EV growth is faster, passenger car adoption is hampered by alternatives like hybrids and CNG vehicles. Experts believe refining government initiatives such as the PLI and advanced cell chemistry schemes could further support EV adoption. Temporarily expanding FAME benefits to include passenger vehicles could also provide a much-needed sales boost. Outside the auto industry, the IPO market in India is thriving, with top offerings like Tata Technologies, Flair Writing Industries, and Gandhar Oil Refinery rapidly attracting investors. Leading airline IndiGo is also planning to launch a premium class and add new services, aiming to draw in more business travelers and compete with rivals like Air India. In addition, creditors are increasingly leveraging insolvency threats to recover dues, as evident in thousands of cases withdrawn after settlements. For continued market updates and expert advice, ETMarkets and The Economic Times remain reliable resources.

article_content: Apple is known for its extensive use of glass in both its retail stores and products, such as display screens, notebook trackpads, and the iPhone 4, which features glass on both the front and back. However, the glass back of the iPhone 4 has reportedly caused the company some issues. A recent report from Gdgt claims that slip-on cases, which cover the back and sometimes the front of the iPhone 4, have contributed to significant cosmetic damage on the rear glass. Particles of dirt and debris can get trapped between the case and the phone, leading over time to scratches that can develop into cracks, similar to chips spreading on a windshield. The problem is reportedly significant enough that Apple's engineers have been thoroughly testing various third-party cases to assess the extent of the damage and prevent it from occurring in future models. This news comes shortly after Apple ended its free iPhone 4 case program and amid reports that mass production of a CDMA version of the iPhone, possibly for Verizon in early 2011, has begun. If design changes are planned for future versions of the iPhone, a back prone to cracking could be delaying the process. This isn't the first time Apple has faced reports of cracked hardware; the Mac G4 Cube (introduced in 2000) and the iPhone 3G were also reported to have developed hairline surface cracks. Similar cracking was seen in the white versions of the MacBook, which Apple began acknowledging and repairing in early 2009. © 2010 CBS Interactive Inc. All rights reserved. article_content: For two years, a 10-meter Rinker 342 Fiesta Vee yacht, valued at approximately $100,000, sat untouched at a marina in Stromstad, Sweden, near the Norwegian border. The keys were left openly tied to the railing, yet no one attempted to take the boat, highlighting the region’s honesty. Local police and residents grew concerned about the missing owner as unpaid mooring fees accumulated. Inside, authorities found Norwegian documents from 2008, their only clue to the owner’s identity. After a police appeal on Facebook attracted Norwegian media attention, the owner came forward, revealing he had simply forgotten about the boat, mistakenly thinking he had sold it years earlier. Inspector Christer Fuxborg, who declined to name the owner, noted, 'I think he must be quite wealthy to forget a boat like this.' Despite being unused for two years, the yacht was reported to be in good condition. The owner now faces the unpaid mooring costs, which are typically $30 to $50 per day during the summer. Inspector Fuxborg commented that paying the fees should not pose a problem for him.

Die Schlüssel waren offen an der Reling befestigt, doch niemand versuchte, das Boot mitzunehmen – ein Beweis für die Ehrlichkeit in der Region. Polizei und Anwohner sorgten sich um den verschwundenen Besitzer, während sich unbezahlte Liegegebühren ansammelten. Im Inneren fanden die Behörden norwegische Dokumente aus dem Jahr 2008 – der einzige Hinweis auf die Identität des Besitzers. Nachdem ein Facebook-Aufruf der Polizei die Aufmerksamkeit norwegischer Medien erregte, meldete sich der Eigentümer und gab an, das Boot einfach vergessen zu haben, weil er dachte, er habe es bereits vor Jahren verkauft. Inspektor Christer Fuxborg, der den Namen des Besitzers nicht preisgab, bemerkte: „Ich glaube, er muss ziemlich wohlhabend sein, um ein Boot wie dieses zu vergessen.“ Trotz zweijährigem Stillstand war die Yacht in gutem Zustand. Nun muss der Eigentümer die aufgelaufenen Liegegebühren zahlen, die im Sommer normalerweise 30 bis 50 US-Dollar pro Tag betragen. Inspektor Fuxborg meinte, das Bezahlen werde für ihn kein Problem sein.

Gary Shteyngart, often dubbed "Scary Gary" in his youth, candidly chronicles his tumultuous journey from a Russian Jewish immigrant to a celebrated American author in his new memoir, "Little Failure." Known for his comedic sharpness in novels like "Absurdistan" and "Super Sad True Love Story," Shteyngart recounts his struggles with belonging, feelings of isolation, and his sometimes wild behavior during his formative years.

The memoir details his early life in Leningrad (now Saint Petersburg) before emigrating to the United States at age seven. Adjusting to American culture was a challenge, both at home and at school. Scenes from his memoir range from humorous, such as his family’s belief they had won the Publishers Clearing House sweepstakes, to bittersweet, such as navigating cultural barriers and familial tensions.

Shteyngart describes how humor became his form of "armor," a way to cope with anxiety and sadness. Stories from his youth include playful rewrites of religious texts, marathon gaming sessions, and a penchant for party antics during his high school and college years. He openly acknowledges his imperfections, reflecting, "The truth of the matter is I was a jerk in many, many ways."

The memoir, written with the help of family and friends who contributed letters and memories, has received praise from prominent critics like Michiko Kakutani of The New York Times and Lisa Zeidner of the Washington Post. Still, Shteyngart awaits the opinions that matter most to him—those of his parents, who face language barriers in reading his work.

His reflections also extend to his experiences with psychoanalysis, where he admits to bending the rules but attributes some personal growth to the process. Shteyngart humorously notes he now sees his analyst only four times a week, rather than the traditional five, signaling a potential readiness to move forward from the past chronicled in "Little Failure."

article_content: When comedian Stephen Colbert won NASA's public poll to name a new node on the International Space Station (ISS), NASA faced a unique challenge. Instead of naming Node 3 after him, NASA chose to name the node 'Tranquility,' referencing the Sea of Tranquility where Apollo 11 landed on the moon. As a tribute to Colbert's victory and strong fan support, the agency named an exercise treadmill after him: the Combined Operational Load Bearing External Resistance Treadmill, or COLBERT. This treadmill helps astronauts stay in shape during long missions. Colbert's energetic campaign, powered by his fans, brought extra attention to the often-overlooked ISS. Although the contest featured public voting, NASA specified in the rules that it would select a name in the agency's best interest, even if it wasn't the top-voted one. Astronaut Sunita 'Suni' Williams announced NASA's decision on 'The Colbert Report' on Comedy Central, leading to a humorous exchange. Colbert quipped that a treadmill was better than a node, comparing it to wanting shoes, not just the box. Other suggested names included 'Serenity,' which fit with node names like 'Harmony.' The publicity around Colbert's involvement boosted the ISS profile, according to Bill Gerstenmaier, NASA's associate administrator for Space Operations. NASA had planned to announce the name at Kennedy Space Center, but switched to Colbert's show after receiving an invitation from his staff. Congressman Chaka Fattah, who advocated for Colbert, called the decision a good compromise and riffed on Neil Armstrong's famous moon landing quote. Colbert is known for rallying fans to get things named after him. In 2006, he won the public vote to name a Hungarian bridge, though the government declined. He also tried to get on the South Carolina presidential primary ballots in 2007, but was unsuccessful. Still, Ben & Jerry’s named an ice cream flavor after him, AmeriCone Dream, and Virgin America named a plane Air Colbert. CNN’s Ed Payne, Shelby Lin, and Ninette Sosa contributed to this report.
translated_content: Als der Komiker Stephen Colbert eine öffentliche Abstimmung der NASA zur Namensgebung eines neuen Moduls der Internationalen Raumstation (ISS) gewann, sah sich die NASA einer besonderen Herausforderung gegenüber. Anstelle von Colberts Namen entschied man sich, das Modul 'Tranquility' zu nennen – in Anlehnung an das Mare Tranquillitatis, wo Apollo 11 auf dem Mond landete. Um Colberts Sieg und die starke Unterstützung seiner Fans zu würdigen, benannte die NASA ein Trainingslaufband nach ihm: das Combined Operational Load Bearing External Resistance Treadmill (COLBERT). Dieses Laufband hilft Astronauten, bei langen Missionen fit zu bleiben. Colberts energiegeladene Kampagne brachte gemeinsam mit seinen Fans zusätzliche Aufmerksamkeit für die oft übersehene ISS. Obwohl die Abstimmung öffentlich war, stellte die NASA in den Regeln klar, dass sie einen Namen im Sinne der Behörde auswählen würde – auch wenn er nicht die meisten Stimmen bekommen würde. Astronautin Sunita 'Suni' Williams verkündete die NASA-Entscheidung in ‚The Colbert Report‘ auf Comedy Central, was für einen humorvollen Austausch sorgte. Colbert scherzte, dass ein Laufband besser sei als ein Modul – schließlich wolle niemand die Box, sondern die Schuhe darin haben. Weitere vorgeschlagene Namen waren ‚Serenity‘, das besser zu bestehenden Modulen wie ‚Harmony‘ gepasst hätte. Die öffentliche Aufmerksamkeit durch Colberts Beteiligung habe das Profil der ISS gestärkt, sagte Bill Gerstenmaier, NASA-Vizeadministrator für Raumfahrtoperationen. Eigentlich sollte die Namensverkündung im Kennedy Space Center stattfinden, aber die NASA wechselte nach einer Einladung von Colberts Team in seine Sendung. Der Abgeordnete Chaka Fattah, der Colbert unterstützte, nannte die Entscheidung einen guten Kompromiss und spielte auf Neil Armstrongs berühmtes Zitat von der Mondlandung an. article_content: The family of a WWII airman who perished during his final mission has finally found the place where he died—only to discover it is set to become a housing development, without allowing archaeological experts to search for bodies or wreckage. Flight engineer Ronald Barton, 34, and his seven crewmates crashed while returning from a bombing raid over Germany in 1944. The exact crash site near Cloppenburg, northern Germany, was lost after the war, only to be recently identified by Barton's family through a thorough search and by contacting residents who remembered the crash. Barton's granddaughters, Julie Barton and Debbie Bartlett, found the crash location by speaking to locals such as Herr Heuermann. They visited the field in Staatsforten, near Varrelbusch, laying roses for the airmen who died. Part of the land has already been cleared for new housing. Local residents remain convinced that human remains and plane wreckage are still underground, but authorities intend to proceed with development after only checking for unexploded ordnance, without allowing a comprehensive archaeological search. Julie and Debbie spent more than 18 months identifying the site. The Royal Australian Air Force and aviation archaeologists assisted them in confirming its location. The sisters spoke with people who witnessed the crash, learning that two crew members were recovered and buried by German soldiers, but six others and much of the wreckage are still believed to be missing. Ms Barton stated that eyewitnesses are convinced remains still lie beneath the field. She is concerned that bulldozers will dig up the land without sufficient checks for remains or aircraft parts. The sisters urge German authorities to treat the site sensitively and involve local archaeologists. They added that support from British authorities was limited. The sisters wish for any discovered remains to be properly buried and any plane parts found to be preserved in a museum. Ronald Barton left behind a 10-year-old son. The crash occurred on October 6, 1944, during the crew’s intended final mission from RAF Metheringham in Lincolnshire, targeting Bremen. The Lancaster lost contact with base and was declared missing. The International Red Cross reported it had crashed, and Germans recovered two bodies. In 1946, an RAF team exhumed and identified Flight Lieutenant John Colclough Barlow and Rear Gunner Sergeant Ronald James Paul; both are buried at Becklingen War Cemetery. The remaining crew—including pilot Douglas Stewart, navigator George Bowering Kirby, wireless operator Gordon Stuart Grogan, bomb aimer Clyde James Royal, and mid-upper gunner James Anthony Fell—have no known grave but are memorialized at Runnymede. Barton's family continues to seek relatives of other crew members to help ensure the crash site is respectfully examined and any remains are given a proper burial.

article_content: Austen Howells, a 40-year-old rugby coach from St Bride's Major near Cardiff, led a double life as a devoted father and husband during the week and as a drug user on weekends. He died after a significant binge involving multiple substances at a friend's stag weekend in Stockport, as revealed by an inquest. Howells, married to NHS Wales executive director Alex Howells, was seen by his family as a health-conscious, home-loving father of two who rarely drank. However, friends knew him as 'Mr all or nothing' who regularly used cocaine and other substances during weekends. In August last year, after a weekend away with 40 friends, Howells died following the use of multiple drugs. A post-mortem found at least five types of drugs in his system, including cocaine, amphetamines, and methadrone. The inquest heard that Howells had bought 150 tablets, referred to as 'super pills', before the stag weekend. He concealed the drugs in his glasses case and travelled with them from Wales to Bredbury Hall Hotel and Country Club in Stockport. Howells had been chosen as master of ceremonies for Benjamin Davies’ upcoming wedding and reportedly contacted Davies prior to the trip to discuss how much cocaine to bring, as well as mentioning 'super pills'. According to Davies, Howells became a regular drug user and developed an addiction to the painkiller Tramadol after an ankle injury. During the stag party, the group began drinking after meeting at a restaurant in South Wales, and the celebrations continued at the hotel. After an all-night binge, Howells was found in his room at around 5:30am, speaking incoherently, with drugs visible on a desk and pills found by friends. He is believed to have taken several 'super pills' and shared them with others. Friends described Howells as living very differently during the week compared to weekends, being homely and placid at home but engaging in excessive substance use during nights out. Some friends stayed with him as his condition deteriorated, describing him as sweating, agitated, and incoherent. Later, Howells was found unresponsive. Toxicology tests revealed cocaine, amphetamines, methadrone, diazepam, tramadol, and AMT—an ecstasy-type drug—in his system. Messages recovered by police indicated habitual drug use and supplying drugs to friends. Howells’ wife told the inquest she was unaware of any substance use, describing him as a committed father and serious sportsman, while friends and family expressed shock at the revelations. Although he sought support for depression, he was never diagnosed clinically. Coroner Joanne Kearsley concluded that no single substance caused Howells’ death, but their combination likely led to cardiac arrest. She emphasized the tragedy, calling it a needless waste and noting the concerning prevalence of drug use in rugby circles.

Nach einer durchgefeierten Nacht wurde Howells gegen 5:30 Uhr morgens im Hotelzimmer vorgefunden, sprach wirr, mit sichtbaren Drogen auf dem Schreibtisch und gefundenen Pillen. Es wird angenommen, dass er mehrere 'Superpillen' nahm und diese mit anderen teilte. Einige Freunde blieben bei ihm, als sich sein Zustand verschlechterte, und beschrieben ihn als schwitzend, unruhig und verwirrt. Später wurde Howells leblos aufgefunden. Freunde und Familie zeigten sich schockiert. Obwohl er sich wegen Depressionen Hilfe gesucht hatte, gab es keine klinische Diagnose. Gerichtsmedizinerin Joanne Kearsley kam zu dem Schluss, dass keine einzelne Substanz Howells’ Tod verursachte, sondern die Kombination aller die wahrscheinlichste Ursache für den Herzstillstand war. Sie betonte die Tragödie und bezeichnete den Verlust als sinnlos, außerdem kritisierte sie die weitverbreitete Drogennutzung in Rugby-Kreisen.

article_content: A moving tribute drawing was widely circulated on Instagram following the devastating attack on Charlie Hebdo in Paris, quickly amassing over 100,000 shares through the @Banksy account. The illustration depicted pencils evolving from whole to broken, and finally multiplying, representing resilience in the face of tragedy. While many assumed Banksy was behind the artwork, his representative clarified to The Independent it was not his piece. Credit was subsequently given to Lucille Clerc, a French illustrator based in London, who had shared the image with the message 'Break one, thousand will rise'. This and other tributes flooded social media as people worldwide honored the 12 victims, including respected cartoonists, lost in the attack.

If you think your home is full of junk, it faces serious competition from the University of Brighton's Waste House—a building made entirely from recycled and surplus materials. The structure incorporates 4,000 VHS tapes, two tons of jeans, and 20,000 toothbrushes, among other discarded items. The project's architects aim to show that such materials can perform as well as conventional, energy-intensive building supplies. Notable features include toothbrushes, many used just once by premium airline passengers at Gatwick, repurposed as insulation in wall cavities. The construction also employs chalk waste mixed with clay for the walls, 500 bike tyres to seal windows and soundproof floors, 2,000 used carpet tiles on floors and walls, and old vinyl banners for vapour control layers, according to Refinery 29.

The Waste House was conceived by Duncan Baker-Brown, an architect and researcher at the University of Brighton's Faculty of Arts. He views the project as an experiment in sustainable living: 'There is no such thing as waste, just stuff in the wrong place.'

This initiative builds on the 2008 'House That Kevin Built'—the UK's first modern, low-energy prefabricated house made exclusively from eco-friendly materials—collaboratively designed with Kevin McCloud of Channel 4's Grand Designs.

'With our students, we've been continually developing new sustainable construction methods and exploring innovative uses for materials to reflect ongoing progress in this field,' says Baker-Brown.

Work on the Waste House began in April and it opened to the public in June. Over the next few years, university students will evaluate the building's exterior and insulation efficiency, testing materials like plastics for their sustainable potential. Insulation throughout includes reused bricks, plywood, wood, plastic razors, denim, DVDs, and video cassettes—all monitored for performance.

The Brighton Waste House aims to demonstrate that low-carbon, recycled materials can rival or exceed the standards set by traditional building products. Upon completion, it is expected to be one of the UK's first sustainable buildings to achieve an A* energy efficiency rating.

article_content: Ajay Prasad is the CEO of GMR Web Team, a healthcare digital marketing agency specializing in patient acquisition and retention. With foot disorders increasing, especially among the elderly, and the global podiatry services market expected to reach $6.1 billion by 2033, effective marketing strategies are essential for podiatry practices. A strong online presence helps connect with patients where they most often begin their search for a doctor—the internet. The modern patient accesses information and services online and values convenience and price transparency in healthcare. As a result, healthcare consumerism has made patients more informed and selective, including in podiatry. Therefore, podiatrists must build a robust online presence and position themselves as trusted care providers and go-to brands for new and existing patients. To increase your patient base, start by defining measurable goals for your marketing, such as targets for new patients, revenue growth, or improved patient satisfaction. Even with podiatry's upward trend, your services are most effective when your online presence is strong. Simple strategies to enhance your presence include: - Creating a professional, user-friendly, mobile-responsive website. - Optimizing your website for search engines by researching and targeting relevant keywords, such as 'podiatrists near me' or 'podiatry services in Texas.' - Structuring website URLs using clear, concise words separated by hyphens, making them readable and informative—an important aspect of on-page SEO. Patients frequently research symptoms and treatments online before seeing a doctor. Providing educational content like blog posts or podcasts can answer their questions and build trust, while also boosting your website’s search rankings and attracting new patients. With 71% of patients using online reviews as a primary factor when searching for a doctor, consistently gathering positive reviews is vital. Authentic feedback from satisfied patients adds to your credibility and reputation without seeming promotional. Engaging patients and encouraging proactive healthcare decisions help establish trust and loyalty. Methods include promoting healthy lifestyles, regular checkups, and sending automated appointment reminders. A good marketing strategy continues after successful treatments. Collect patient feedback through surveys, emails, or text messages to assess satisfaction and identify areas for improvement. Satisfied patients are more likely to leave positive reviews and refer others. Once you have established a loyal patient network, focus on retention. Strategies such as personalized care plans, follow-up care, appointment reminders, and loyalty programs can increase patient retention and advocacy. Investing in patient referral programs can be highly effective. Implement this by placing referral signs in your clinic, requesting referrals from satisfied patients, and offering incentives like health benefits or gift cards. Regularly measure and analyze the effectiveness of your marketing by tracking patient sources, conversion rates, total investments, revenue, and cost per patient acquisition. Use this information to refine your strategies. In conclusion, a patient-focused marketing approach is key to a successful podiatry practice. Educate and engage your patients, build trust, and use referral programs to grow your brand. These strategies will help expand your practice and achieve long-term success. article_content: Asian investment in renewable energy is booming, with funding increasing by 23% annually and reaching $345 billion for wind, solar, and electric vehicles in 2022, as reported by Zero Carbon Analytics. In 2022, Asia contributed over half of the world's renewable energy capacity, propelled mainly by progress in India, China, and Vietnam. Asia's electric vehicle sector, especially electric motorbikes and scooters, experienced massive growth—sales rose by 3,000% between 2015 and 2022. Nevertheless, the region accounts for about 51% of global greenhouse gas emissions because of extensive coal power use in India and China, though both nations have pledged to reach net-zero emissions long-term. The report, 'A driving force: Asia's Energy Transition,' underscores Asia's leading position in wind and solar capacity growth worldwide. Asia's total investment in renewables hit $532 billion in 2022, nearly two-thirds of all global spending in this sector. India is rapidly expanding its renewable capacity beyond its coal power growth, while China has led the world in wind and solar deployment—doubling its capacity approximately every 1.5 years for wind and every 2.5 years for solar since 2000. The Asia Pacific region, home to 4.3 billion people, faces significant climate risks, such as rising sea levels, extreme weather, and threats to biodiversity and water supplies. Commentators like Aarti Khosla and Li Shuo highlight Asia's key role in global clean energy advancement and economic growth, noting China's momentum toward surpassing its 2030 renewable targets.

article_content: Marking one year since Nelson Mandela's death, South Africans came together to commemorate the influential leader’s legacy. Mandela, who died aged 95 on December 5, 2013, after a lengthy illness, was remembered with ceremonies that included laying a wreath at his statue in Pretoria, a memorial cricket match, the sound of vuvuzelas, and collective moments of silence. Graca Machel, Mandela's widow, attended the wreath-laying and spoke about how her husband’s legacy spans across South Africa, Africa, and worldwide. She encouraged people to continue his work of forgiveness and love, ensuring that his principles endure. Machel shared the personal sense of loss she felt after his passing, but also the comfort she drew from believing he was reunited with late friends such as Oliver Tambo, who partnered with Mandela to open the nation’s first black law firm. Mandela’s life was defined by his struggle against apartheid, which led to 27 years in prison, and by his role as South Africa’s first black president in 1994. His later years were quieter, yet he remained highly respected, fondly known as Madiba or Tata. Memorial events also featured a cricket match, interfaith prayers, and a special tribute with three minutes and seven seconds of vuvuzelas and traditional horns, followed by three minutes of silence—symbolizing the 67 years Mandela dedicated to public service.

article_content: This Sunday, Buenos Aires hosts a crucial presidential runoff as Argentina endures its deepest economic crisis in recent memory. Inflation exceeds 140%, poverty levels climb, and the national currency is in decline. The contest pits Javier Milei, a far-right libertarian promising sweeping reforms, against Sergio Massa, the current economy minister leading the Peronist coalition. Javier Milei, 53, is relatively new to the political scene, having joined Congress in 2021 with his La Libertad Avanza (Liberty Advances) party. Noted for his provocative style and forceful critiques of Argentina's political elite, Milei often uses dramatic symbols—like wielding a chainsaw—at rallies to illustrate his intent to cut state spending. His anti-establishment rhetoric and social media presence have resonated especially with younger voters frustrated with the job market. An economist by training, Milei advocates for reducing government intervention, considers taxation oppressive, and is recognized for his unconventional character. He has not married, refers to his cloned bull mastiffs as 'four-legged children,' and frequently performs at rallies. Comparisons to Donald Trump and Jair Bolsonaro stem from his outsider image and bold statements, including skepticism about climate change and criticism of Pope Francis. On the other side, Sergio Massa, 51, brings years of political experience. As economy minister and leader of the Unión por la Patria coalition, he appeals to working-class voters and unions—the backbone of Peronism. Massa emerged first in last month's voting with 36.7%, ahead of Milei’s 30%. He’s worked to separate his campaign from unpopular figures in the current administration. Milei proposes deep cuts to public spending—aiming to reduce it by 15% of GDP—halve government ministries, abolish the central bank, and dollarize the economy. His platform extends to easing gun restrictions, limiting abortion, providing school vouchers, and narrowing diplomatic ties to select nations like the US and Israel, though trade with China and others would continue. Massa, often described as a moderate centrist, wants controlled fiscal reduction, intends to keep essential subsidies, and plans to renegotiate the $44 billion IMF loan. He warns voters of the possible impacts of Milei’s drastic economic plans and has enacted temporary tax cuts, drawing criticism for their potential political motives. Voting is compulsory in Argentina. Both candidates are courting the support of over six million people who voted for Patricia Bullrich, a center-right candidate who finished third. While Bullrich and former President Mauricio Macri have endorsed Milei, their coalition remains neutral. Many voters remain divided—some wary of Milei's temperament and proposals, others disillusioned by ongoing economic woes—leading some to consider submitting blank ballots. With the vote expected to be close, uncertainty looms over Argentina’s economic stability, with concerns about currency devaluation after the election. Milei’s team has pre-emptively raised issues of potential election fraud, formally requesting increased transparency despite lacking concrete evidence.
translated_content: An diesem Sonntag findet in Buenos Aires eine entscheidende Stichwahl um das Präsidentenamt statt, während Argentinien mit einer der schwersten Wirtschaftskrisen seiner Geschichte kämpft. Die Inflation liegt bei über 140 %, die Armutsquote steigt, die Landeswährung verliert an Wert. Im Mittelpunkt steht das Duell zwischen Javier Milei, einem rechtspopulistischen Libertären mit radikalen Reformplänen, und Sergio Massa, dem derzeitigen Wirtschaftsminister und Anführer der peronistischen Koalition. Javier Milei, 53, ist ein politischer Neuling und seit 2021 mit seiner Partei La Libertad Avanza (Die Freiheit schreitet voran) im Parlament vertreten. Er ist bekannt für seinen provokanten Stil und scharfe Kritik am politischen Establishment. Bei Wahlkampfauftritten schwingt er gerne eine Kettensäge als Symbol für seinen Willen zum radikalen Staatsabbau. Besonders junge Wähler, die sich vom Arbeitsmarkt ausgeschlossen fühlen, begeistert er mit seiner Anti-Establishment-Rhetorik und starken Social-Media-Präsenz. Der studierte Ökonom will die staatliche Einflussnahme massiv verringern, hält Steuern für Unterdrückung und gilt als unkonventionell. Er ist unverheiratet und nennt seine geklonten Bullmastiffs „vierbeinige Kinder“. Auf Veranstaltungen zeigt er sich oft extravagant. Oft wird er mit Donald Trump und Jair Bolsonaro verglichen – als Außenseiter mit markigen Worten, etwa durch seine Klimawandelskepsis oder Kritik an Papst Franziskus. Sergio Massa ist 51 Jahre alt und ein politischer Routinier. Als Wirtschaftsminister und Vorsitzender der Koalition Unión por la Patria spricht er insbesondere Arbeitnehmer und Gewerkschaften an, also die Kernwählerschaft des Peronismus. Bei der Wahl im letzten Monat lag Massa mit 36,7 % vor Milei (30 %). Im Wahlkampf grenzt er sich von unbeliebten Regierungsmitgliedern ab. Milei plant drastische Kürzungen der Staatsausgaben um 15 % des Bruttoinlandsprodukts, eine Halbierung der Ministerien, die Abschaffung der Zentralbank und eine Dollarisierung der Wirtschaft. Zusätzlich will er das Waffenrecht lockern, Abtreibungen stärker beschränken, Bildungsgutscheine einführen und die diplomatischen Beziehungen hauptsächlich auf die USA und Israel begrenzen – der Handel mit China und anderen soll jedoch weitergehen. Massa gilt als moderater Zentrist. Er strebt vorsichtige Haushaltskonsolidierung an, will wichtige Subventionen beibehalten und einen neuen Vertrag mit dem IWF über das 44-Milliarden-Dollar-Darlehen erreichen. Er warnt vor den Folgen der radikalen Kursänderungen Mileis und hat vor der Wahl einige Steuern gesenkt, was von Kritikern als Wahlstrategie gesehen wird. In Argentinien besteht Wahlpflicht. Über sechs Millionen Wählerinnen und Wähler, die sich in der ersten Runde für die zentristisch-rechte Patricia Bullrich entschieden hatten, sind jetzt entscheidend. Bullrich und Ex-Präsident Mauricio Macri unterstützen Milei, das konservative Lager bleibt aber offiziell neutral. Viele Menschen sind unentschlossen – manche fürchten Mileis Art und Pläne, andere sind enttäuscht von der Wirtschaftspolitik und erwägen einen leeren Wahlzettel. Das Rennen ist offen, weshalb die Sorge vor einer weiteren Destabilisierung und Währungsabwertung nach der Wahl groß ist. Das Milei-Lager äußerte bereits Manipulationsvorwürfe und fordert mehr Transparenz – bislang fehlen aber belastbare Beweise.

article_content: Seth Meyers has officially been named the new host for NBC’s late night show, succeeding fellow Saturday Night Live (SNL) veteran Jimmy Fallon. Meyers, 39, who has been with SNL since 2001—including his role as 'Weekend Update' anchor—will take over the 12:35am program. Fallon, who has hosted the show since 2009, will move up an hour to replace Jay Leno as host of 'The Tonight Show' in 2014. Meyers’ show will broadcast from New York’s Rockefeller Center, just like Fallon’s upcoming 'Tonight Show.' While Fallon is set to step in after the 2014 Olympics, Meyers’ premiere date has not yet been set. Both programs will be overseen by longtime SNL producer Lorne Michaels, who was reportedly especially supportive of Meyers for the role. Other contenders considered included SNL alum Tina Fey. Meyers reportedly declined an opportunity in July 2012 to co-host 'Live with Kelly!' on ABC—declining to replace Regis Philbin—citing his love for SNL at the time, and the position ultimately went to former NFL star Michael Strahan. NBC is also building a state-of-the-art studio for Fallon at 30 Rockefeller Plaza, while a proposed New York State budget includes a 30% tax credit for TV programs that relocate production to New York State. This amendment would extend the incentive to established shows, aligning with 'The Tonight Show’s' planned move from Los Angeles, where it’s been produced since 1972; previously, it filmed in New York.

Fallon, der die Show seit 2009 moderierte, rückt eine Stunde vor und übernimmt nach den Olympischen Winterspielen 2014 von Jay Leno die Moderation der 'Tonight Show'. Die Sendung von Meyers wird – genau wie Fallons künftige 'Tonight Show' – aus dem Rockefeller Center in New York ausgestrahlt. Während Fallons Wechsel nach den Olympischen Spielen feststeht, ist Meyers' Starttermin noch offen. Beide Programme werden vom langjährigen SNL-Produzenten Lorne Michaels betreut, der sich offensichtlich besonders für Meyers eingesetzt hat. Diese Änderung würde den Anreiz auch auf etablierte Sendungen ausweiten – passend zu den Plänen, die 'Tonight Show' von Los Angeles, wo sie seit 1972 produziert wurde, zurück nach New York zu holen. Davor wurde sie bereits dort gedreht.

article_content: Senator Tim Scott, Republican from South Carolina, has suspended his campaign for the Republican presidential nomination. He made the announcement during a Fox News interview on 'Sunday Night in America,' surprising host Trey Gowdy. Scott launched his campaign in May, centering it on his Christian faith and his experience as a Black man raised by a single mother in the South. He is currently one of only three Black members of the Senate and the only Black Republican senator. Scott’s political career began in 2010 when he won South Carolina’s 1st Congressional District. His victory was celebrated by South Carolina’s Republican Party, which aimed to broaden its appeal to Black voters. In 2012, then-Governor Nikki Haley appointed him as the state’s junior senator. Throughout his campaign, Scott highlighted his life story as evidence of America being a land of opportunity. He frequently recounted his upbringing and the positive influence of a Chick-fil-A manager who mentored him as a struggling student. Scott’s message, arguing that structural racism is not as severe as claimed by Democrats, resonated with some white Republican voters, but less so among Black voters, who found his perspective less relatable. Scott’s performances in the three Republican primary debates were lackluster, and he often faded into the background. As a result, he was unlikely to qualify for the fourth debate in Alabama. Meanwhile, former President Donald Trump continues as the frontrunner in the GOP primary, maintaining a strong lead over other candidates. Earlier in the campaign, Scott raised $5.8 million over the summer, as donors sought viable alternatives to Trump. However, as Scott’s polling numbers remained weak, major donors began withdrawing their support. One of Scott’s largest backers, Trust in the Mission PAC, announced it would reduce its fall advertising for him, explaining to donors that it did not want to spend money when the electorate was not focused on a Trump alternative.

Er gab diese Entscheidung in einem Fox-News-Interview in der Sendung 'Sunday Night in America' bekannt und überraschte damit den Moderator Trey Gowdy. Scott startete seine Kampagne im Mai, wobei er seinen christlichen Glauben und seine Erfahrungen als schwarzer Mann, der von einer alleinerziehenden Mutter im Süden aufwuchs, in den Mittelpunkt stellte. Er ist momentan einer von nur drei schwarzen Senatoren und der einzige schwarze republikanische Senator. Scotts politische Karriere begann 2010, als er den 1. Kongressdistrikt von South Carolina gewann. Sein Erfolg wurde von der Republikanischen Partei des Bundesstaates gefeiert, da sie ihre Attraktivität für schwarze Wähler steigern wollte. 2012 ernannte ihn die damalige Gouverneurin Nikki Haley zum Junior-Senator des Bundesstaates. Im Wahlkampf hob Scott häufig seine Lebensgeschichte hervor, um zu zeigen, dass Amerika das Land der Möglichkeiten ist. Oft erzählte er von seiner Kindheit und dem positiven Einfluss eines Managers bei Chick-fil-A, der ihn als strauchelnden Schüler förderte. Scotts Botschaft, dass struktureller Rassismus nicht so gravierend sei, wie von den Demokraten behauptet, fand bei einigen weißen republikanischen Wählern Anklang, allerdings weniger bei schwarzen Wählern, die diese Sichtweise weniger nachvollziehen konnten. Seine Auftritte bei den drei republikanischen TV-Debatten blieben eher unauffällig und er trat meist in den Hintergrund. Folglich war es unwahrscheinlich, dass er sich für die vierte Debatte in Alabama qualifizieren würde. Der frühere Präsident Donald Trump bleibt weiterhin der Spitzenkandidat bei den Republikanern und hat einen deutlichen Vorsprung vor den anderen Bewerbern. Zu Beginn der Kampagne sammelte Scott im Sommer 5,8 Millionen Dollar, weil Spender Alternativen zu Trump suchten. Doch als Scotts Umfragewerte niedrig blieben, zogen sich wichtige Unterstützer zurück. Einer von Scotts größten Unterstützern, das Trust in the Mission PAC, kündigte an, die Werbeausgaben im Herbst zu reduzieren und begründete dies damit, dass das Geld nicht ausgegeben werde, solange sich die Wähler nicht auf eine Alternative zu Trump konzentrieren.

For nearly twenty years, Richard and Cathy Brown played the same lottery numbers each week without success. But during a ten-week sailing trip around Britain, their fortunes changed dramatically. The retired couple from Ipswich, Suffolk, were just 250 miles into their planned 2,500-mile journey when Richard, 66, checked the lottery results on his phone and discovered they had won £6 million.

The Browns, together for 39 years, had played the same numbers since 1994. After discovering their win, they stored the ticket safely under the boat’s chart table before heading into Newcastle to celebrate with a gin and tonic. The next day, they turned their yacht, Brave, around and sailed home to claim their prize.

Upon returning to Ipswich Marina, Cathy, 64, said, “This is more money than we could spend in a lifetime.” High on their wish list is a £350,000 replacement for their 11-year-old Grand Soleil yacht, considering a top-range German Dehler. Richard is interested in a Porsche 911, while Cathy is content with their current VW Passat estate. The former journalists, who have been sailing for 30 years, downsized their Suffolk country home to a similar-sized house in Ipswich in 2005 to afford their £100,000 yacht.

Before their trip, Richard bought a month’s supply of lottery tickets at a local Sainsbury’s. They have played the numbers 3, 5, 25, 33, 34, and 35 twice a week since 1994. Their win was confirmed via the National Lottery app. “Cathy was looking over my shoulder as we matched all six numbers,” Richard recalled. “I told her, ‘You’re a millionaire.’ We hid the ticket under the chart table—there aren't many pirates in the North Sea!”

The couple, who have no children and worked at the East Anglian Daily Times, had planned to sail around Britain for a second time. Now, they may buy a new house and plan to share a significant part of their winnings with relatives, friends, and charities close to their hearts. “We already had a great life before the win. This is just the icing on the cake,” said Cathy.

Meanwhile, 84-year-old Gloria Mackenzie from Zephyrhills, Florida, became America’s largest individual lottery winner, claiming a $590 million Powerball jackpot (lump sum: £241 million). She bought the ticket after another customer let her go ahead in line and will split her winnings with her son.

The article also listed the biggest UK lottery winners, with Colin and Chris Weir at the top with £161.6 million.

article_content: In southwest Atlanta, homeowner Susan Hodgson is considering her options after her family’s vacant house was mistakenly demolished by the company ‘You Call It We Haul It.’ Hodgson discovered what had happened when she returned from a trip and found the property reduced to rubble. She told the Associated Press she was ‘furious’ and in disbelief. While she was away, a neighbor called her to ask if she had ordered the house to be torn down. Hodgson had not, and the neighbor watched as workers finished demolishing the property. According to Hodgson, the crew’s supervisor checked paperwork and admitted to being at the wrong address. She also claims the workers were rude when confronted by the neighbor. Hodgson says her family made sure the property, vacant for about 15 years, was boarded up and maintained, with taxes paid up. She has since reported the incident to police and consulted with attorneys, but no clear resolution has emerged. The demolition company has not reached out to her. In a statement to WAGA-TV, ‘You Call It We Haul It’ said it is investigating the incident and intends to resolve the issue. Hodgson remains frustrated by the lack of communication, saying it’s hard to believe someone could destroy her property and not even apologize or offer to fix the mistake.
translated_content: Im Südwesten von Atlanta überlegt Hausbesitzerin Susan Hodgson, wie sie weiter vorgehen soll, nachdem ihr lange leerstehendes Familienhaus versehentlich von der Firma 'You Call It We Haul It' abgerissen wurde. Als Hodgson von einer Reise zurückkehrte, fand sie nur noch einen Schutthaufen vor. Gegenüber der Associated Press erklärte sie, sie sei ‚wütend‘ und fassungslos. Während ihrer Abwesenheit rief eine Nachbarin an und fragte, ob sie den Abriss des Hauses beauftragt habe. Das verneinte Hodgson, und die Nachbarin beobachtete, wie die Bauarbeiter das Haus komplett abtrugen. Laut Hodgson prüfte der Bauleiter später die Unterlagen und gab zu, die falsche Adresse erwischt zu haben. Außerdem meint sie, die Arbeiter seien sehr unhöflich zur Nachbarin gewesen. Hodgson sagt, ihre Familie habe das Haus, das etwa 15 Jahre leer stand, stets abgesichert und gepflegt, auch die Steuern seien bezahlt worden. Sie habe Anzeige bei der Polizei erstattet und Anwälte eingeschaltet, bisher aber ohne klare Lösung. Das Abrissunternehmen hat sich bisher nicht direkt bei ihr gemeldet. article_content: A comprehensive internal review at Penn State University found that legendary head football coach Joe Paterno and several top officials failed to act on reports of child abuse, allowing assistant coach Jerry Sandusky’s misconduct to continue for years. The report, prepared by former FBI Director Louis Freeh after months of investigation, concluded that Paterno and others showed 'callous and shocking disregard for child victims' and helped create an environment in which Sandusky was able to target more victims. Penn State trustee Kenneth Frazier, who led the committee addressing the Sandusky case, stated that Paterno and key university leaders were guilty of 'inexcusable failures' in protecting children. However, he noted that Paterno's legacy is complex, acknowledging both his positive and negative actions. The release of the report sparked widespread reactions on social media, with many condemning the support that had existed for Paterno and criticizing students who protested his firing. Some community members, like State College resident Kathy Gburuk, insisted Paterno was made a scapegoat and that the football program itself was not responsible for Sandusky’s actions. Students and alumni expressed mixed feelings—some accepting that Paterno bore responsibility, others defending him. Paterno, who died in January, defended his actions in a letter written before his death, stating the allegations were not an indictment of the football program. The Freeh report detailed that Paterno and other senior officials concealed crucial information to avoid negative publicity. Evidence showed Paterno was aware of a 1998 investigation into Sandusky but did not take further action. In February 2001, after graduate assistant Mike McQueary reported witnessing an incident involving Sandusky, Paterno initially planned to alert child welfare authorities, but, after discussion, no report was made. None of the university leaders confronted Sandusky or informed the Board of Trustees; 'nothing was done and Sandusky was allowed to continue with impunity,' according to the report. The Paterno family released a statement acknowledging mistakes but stated that Joe Paterno supported a full investigation, acted on the information he had, and was not aware of the full extent of Sandusky’s crimes. Despite the controversy, Penn State has raised more than $200 million since the scandal became public. Supporters emphasize Paterno’s contributions to the university and his influence on students, alumni, and the football program. The community remains divided on how to honor his legacy. Karen Peetz, chairwoman of the Board of Trustees, said the question of honoring Paterno is sensitive and will be considered by the entire university community. Many hope Penn State can learn from the scandal and move forward.

Der Bericht, erstellt vom ehemaligen FBI-Direktor Louis Freeh nach monatelangen Ermittlungen, kam zu dem Schluss, dass Paterno und andere eine 'kaltherzige und schockierende Gleichgültigkeit gegenüber den Opfern' zeigten und ein Umfeld schufen, in dem Sandusky weitere Opfer finden konnte. Penn State-Treuhänder Kenneth Frazier, der den Ausschuss im Sandusky-Fall leitete, sagte, dass Paterno und die wichtigsten Uni-Leiter 'nicht zu entschuldigende Versäumnisse' beim Schutz von Kindern zeigten. Er betonte jedoch, dass Paternos Vermächtnis komplex sei, mit positiven wie negativen Seiten. Die Veröffentlichung des Berichts löste breite Reaktionen in den sozialen Medien aus: Viele verurteilten die bisherige Unterstützung für Paterno und kritisierten die Studierenden, die gegen seine Entlassung protestierten. Einige Community-Mitglieder, wie die Bewohnerin von State College, Kathy Gburuk, meinten, Paterno sei zum Sündenbock gemacht worden und das Football-Programm selbst trage keine direkte Verantwortung für Sanduskys Taten. Studierende und Alumni zeigten gemischte Gefühle – einige geben Paterno eine Mitschuld, andere verteidigen ihn. Paterno, der im Januar verstarb, verteidigte in einem vor seinem Tod verfassten Brief sein Verhalten und erklärte, die Vorwürfe seien keine Anklage gegen das Football-Programm. Der Freeh-Bericht stellte allerdings dar, dass Paterno und andere ranghohe Uni-Mitglieder bedeutende Informationen verschwiegen, um negative Publicity zu vermeiden. Beweise zeigten, dass Paterno bereits 1998 von Ermittlungen gegen Sandusky wusste, aber nicht weiter handelte. Im Februar 2001 meldete Graduate Assistant Mike McQueary einen Vorfall mit Sandusky; zunächst wollte Paterno die Kinderschutzbehörden einschalten, nach Gesprächen wurde dies jedoch unterlassen. Keiner der Uni-Leiter stellte Sandusky zur Rede oder informierte das Kuratorium; laut Bericht wurde 'nichts getan, und Sandusky konnte ungestraft weitermachen'. Die Paterno-Familie veröffentlichte eine Stellungnahme, in der Fehler eingeräumt wurden; gleichzeitig betonte sie aber, dass Joe Paterno eine vollständige Aufklärung unterstützte, nach bestem Wissen handelte und das Ausmaß von Sanduskys Vergehen nicht kannte. Trotz der Kontroverse hat Penn State seit Bekanntwerden des Skandals über 200 Millionen Dollar an Spenden eingenommen. Unterstützer verweisen auf Paternos Leistungen für die Universität und seinen Einfluss auf Studierende, Alumni und das Football-Team. Die Gemeinschaft ist sich uneinig, wie mit seinem Vermächtnis umgegangen werden soll. Karen Peetz, Vorsitzende des Kuratoriums, sagte, die Frage, ob Paterno geehrt werden soll, sei sensibel und bedürfe der Diskussion in der gesamten Universitätsgemeinschaft. Viele hoffen, dass Penn State aus dem Skandal lernt und einen Neuanfang wagt.

article_content: IMAX is further expanding its presence in Asia by strengthening its partnership with Hengdian Films. The two companies have signed an agreement to install 20 new IMAX with Laser systems across China, marking IMAX’s largest deal for new systems in four years. This expansion highlights ongoing strong demand in China for premium movie experiences, featuring both Hollywood and local films. The new IMAX installations will debut in Jingdezhen, Ulanqab, and Zhangjiakou, marking the first time IMAX will be available in these cities. Additionally, new locations are planned for Hangzhou, Guangzhou, Chengdu, Jiujiang, Hohhot, and Yangzhou, with more to be announced. The agreement follows IMAX China’s most successful summer at the box office, with Oppenheimer earning over $18.4 million, accounting for 30% of its opening weekend box office through less than 1% of China’s screens. "Creation of the Gods" became IMAX China's all-time best summer title, capturing 10% of its total gross, and "The Wandering Earth 2" delivered IMAX’s highest-ever Chinese New Year box office, becoming the top local-language IMAX film to date. Hengdian Films, established in 2015, is involved in film and television production, distribution, exhibition, and related ventures. The company operates 503 theaters with 3,154 screens across 197 cities in 29 provinces. With the new agreement, Hengdian will operate 27 IMAX locations. Xu Tianfu, Chairman of Hengdian Films, stated, "We are delighted to further strengthen our partnership with IMAX. This agreement is an important step in our strategy to develop multiplex locations and underscores our confidence in China’s film market. This year has been pivotal for the industry’s recovery, with strong audiences for high-quality, premium experiences." IMAX CEO Rich Gelfond added, "We are excited to expand into new markets with Hengdian Films as our network grows globally. China’s rapid box office rebound post-COVID, fueled by a mix of Hollywood and local titles, continues to drive growth for IMAX."

article_content: A mining company may have discovered the largest gold deposit ever found in the British Isles, according to its chairman. The price of gold is at historic highs, making the find potentially very valuable. Drill samples indicate that over 1 million ounces of gold could be located beneath the rolling Irish countryside, said Richard Conroy, chairman of Dublin-based Conroy Diamonds and Gold. With gold prices near record levels, the deposit could be worth up to $300 million, Conroy told CNN. The company has spent 10 years searching for gold across a 1,500-square-kilometer (600-square-mile) area spanning the border between Northern Ireland and the Republic of Ireland. The discovery site is near Clontibret, a village in the northern part of Ireland. 'I think it's a major development in Ireland that we now have a significant gold resource,' Conroy said. 'It's the largest amount of gold, the largest number of ounces, that's ever been reported in Ireland, or in either Britain or Ireland.' Currently, gold is priced at about $900 an ounce on global markets. After accounting for mine construction and operational costs, Conroy estimated that the deposit near Clontibret could be worth roughly $300 million. The company plans additional drilling and feasibility studies before proceeding further. However, an analyst cautioned that the reported volume of gold is still only an estimate. 'Until you've actually mined the stuff, there's always a moderate level of uncertainty,' said William Tankard, senior analyst at metals consultancy GFMS in London. If confirmed, a deposit of 1 million ounces would be significant for both Conroy and Ireland, Tankard said. Ireland has only small precious metal deposits, and nothing as substantial as this find, he noted. Conroy added that there is currently only one active gold mine in Ireland. 'By no means is it world-leading, but a million ounces is certainly worth thinking about,' Tankard said. He also noted that the deposit's value will depend on the gold's quality and concentration.

Bohrproben deuten darauf hin, dass sich mehr als 1 Million Unzen Gold unter der hügeligen irischen Landschaft befinden könnten, erklärte Richard Conroy, Vorsitzender von Conroy Diamonds and Gold mit Sitz in Dublin. Bei den derzeit nahe Rekordhöhe liegenden Goldpreisen könnte das Vorkommen bis zu 300 Millionen US-Dollar wert sein, sagte Conroy gegenüber CNN. Das Unternehmen hat 10 Jahre lang in einem 1.500 Quadratkilometer (600 Quadratmeilen) großen Gebiet, das die Grenze zwischen Nordirland und der Republik Irland überspannt, nach Gold gesucht. Der Fundort liegt in der Nähe von Clontibret, einem Dorf im Norden Irlands. 'Ich denke, es ist eine bedeutende Entwicklung für Irland, dass wir nun über eine beachtliche Goldressource verfügen', sagte Conroy. 'Es ist die größte Menge an Gold, die größte Zahl an Unzen, die jemals in Irland oder auf den Britischen Inseln gemeldet wurde.' Derzeit liegt der Goldpreis auf dem Weltmarkt bei etwa 900 US-Dollar pro Unze. Nach Abzug der Kosten für Bau und Betrieb der Mine schätzte Conroy, dass das Vorkommen bei Clontibret ungefähr 300 Millionen US-Dollar wert sein könnte. Das Unternehmen plant weitere Bohrungen und Machbarkeitsstudien, bevor es weitere Schritte unternimmt. Ein Analyst warnte jedoch, dass die angegebene Goldmenge bislang nur eine Schätzung ist. 'Solange man das Material nicht tatsächlich abgebaut hat, bleibt immer ein gewisses Maß an Unsicherheit', sagte William Tankard, leitender Analyst beim Metallberatungsunternehmen GFMS in London. Falls bestätigt, wäre ein Vorkommen von 1 Million Unzen sowohl für Conroy als auch für Irland bedeutend, sagte Tankard. Irland verfügt über nur geringe Edelmetallvorkommen, nichts annähernd so Großes wie dieser Fund, stellte er fest. Conroy ergänzte, dass derzeit nur eine aktive Goldmine in Irland existiert. 'Weltweit führend ist das zwar keineswegs, aber eine Million Unzen ist auf jeden Fall beachtenswert', sagte Tankard. Er wies auch darauf hin, dass der Wert des Vorkommens von der Qualität und Konzentration des Goldes abhängen wird.
